             "parent_after": None, "error": None, "mono_end": None}
    proof["parent_before"] = observe(os.getpid(), observer_role, phase + "_parent_before", deadline)
    proof["target"] = observe(pid, role, phase, deadline)
    proof["parent_after"] = observe(os.getpid(), observer_role, phase + "_parent_after", deadline)
    a, b, c = proof["parent_before"]["identity"], proof["target"]["identity"], proof["parent_after"]["identity"]
    if not identity_valid(expected_observer) or not identity_valid(intended):
        proof["error"] = "JOIN_EXPECTED_OBSERVER_OR_INTENDED_TARGET_MISSING"
    elif a is None or b is None or c is None:
        proof["error"] = "JOIN_PRECHECK_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE"
    elif a["pid"] != os.getpid() or fingerprint(a) != fingerprint(expected_observer) or \
            fingerprint(c) != fingerprint(expected_observer):
        proof["error"] = "JOIN_OBSERVER_NOT_EXPECTED_INCARNATION"
    elif intended["pid"] != pid or b["pid"] != pid or b["ppid"] != a["pid"] or fingerprint(b) != fingerprint(intended):
        proof["error"] = "JOIN_TARGET_NOT_INTENDED_CHILD_INCARNATION"
    proof["mono_end"] = time.monotonic()
    return proof


def join_child(pid, role, coop, expected_observer, intended):
    """WNOHANG-only join bound to its canonical role, actual observer, intended incarnation and ORIGINAL cutoff.
    Once a wait call is made nothing escapes: a destructive result is latched before later clocks/evidence work."""
    join_role, observer_source, intended_source = JOIN_BINDINGS[role]
    observer_role, deadline_role = JOIN_ROLES[join_role]
    deadline, life_deadline = coop[deadline_role], coop["mono_life_deadline"]
    report = {"role": role, "join_role": join_role, "observer_role": observer_role, "observer": os.getpid(),
              "pid": pid, "deadline_role": deadline_role, "deadline_mono": deadline,
              "mono_life_deadline": life_deadline, "expected_observer_source": list(observer_source),
              "expected_observer_identity": expected_observer, "intended_source": list(intended_source),
              "intended_identity": intended, "mono_start": time.monotonic(), "mono_end": None, "precheck": None,
              "precheck_ok": False, "wait_options": ["WNOHANG"], "wait_options_value": os.WNOHANG, "calls": 0,
              "interruptions": 0, "first_call": None, "last_call": None, "resolved": False, "wait_status": None,
              "exit_code": None, "mono_reaped": None, "error": None, "unresolved_observation": None,
              "unresolved_observation_error": None}
    try:
        report["precheck"] = join_precheck(pid, role, join_role, observer_role, deadline, expected_observer, intended)
        report["precheck_ok"] = report["precheck"]["error"] is None
        if not report["precheck_ok"]:
            report["error"] = report["precheck"]["error"]  # Never wait on an unbound target.
        while report["precheck_ok"] and not report["resolved"] and report["error"] is None:
            mono_call = time.monotonic()
            if mono_call >= deadline:
                break
            report["calls"] += 1
            call = {"index": report["calls"], "pid": pid, "options": os.WNOHANG, "mono_call": mono_call,
                    "mono_return": None, "returned_pid": None, "returned_status": None, "error": None}
            if report["first_call"] is None:
                report["first_call"] = call
            report["last_call"] = call
            returned = None
            try:
                returned = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
            except InterruptedError as error:
                call["error"] = repr(error)
                report["interruptions"] += 1
            except Exception as error:
                call["error"] = repr(error)
                report["error"] = "WAIT_CALL_ERROR"
            if returned is not None:
                # Latch the destructive native result BEFORE any clock read that could fail.
                call["returned_pid"], call["returned_status"] = returned
                if returned[0] == pid:
                    report["resolved"], report["wait_status"] = True, returned[1]
                    try:
                        report["exit_code"] = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(returned[1])
                    except ValueError:
                        report["error"] = "WAIT_STATUS_NOT_EXIT_OR_SIGNAL"
                elif returned[0] != 0:
                    report["error"] = "WAIT_RETURNED_UNEXPECTED_PID"
            call["mono_return"] = time.monotonic()
            if report["resolved"]:
                report["mono_reaped"] = call["mono_return"]
                if report["mono_reaped"] >= deadline and report["error"] is None:
                    report["error"] = "WAIT_COMPLETED_AFTER_ABSOLUTE_DEADLINE"
            elif returned is not None and returned[0] == 0:
                time.sleep(min(POLL_S, max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
    except Exception as error:
        report["error"] = report["error"] or "JOIN_EVIDENCE_ERROR " + repr(error)
    if not report["resolved"]:
        if report["error"] is None:
            report["error"] = "WAIT_UNRESOLVED_AT_ABSOLUTE_DEADLINE"
        try:
            report["unresolved_observation"] = observe(pid, role, "unresolved_join", life_deadline)
        except Exception as error:
            report["unresolved_observation_error"] = repr(error)
    try:
        report["mono_end"] = time.monotonic()
    except Exception as error:
        report["error"] = report["error"] or "JOIN_END_CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE " + repr(error)
    return report


def join_ok(report):
    return report["precheck_ok"] and report["resolved"] and report["error"] is None and report["exit_code"] == 0


def fork_body(body, deadline):
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        try:
            body()
        except BaseException as error:
            try:
                complete_write(2, ("DESCENDANT_ERROR %r\n" % error).encode(), deadline)
            except BaseException:
                pass
            os._exit(1)
        os._exit(0)
    return pid


def identity_wait(pid, role, phase, coop, deadline_role, predicate):
    deadline = coop[deadline_role]
    proof = {"role": role, "pid": pid, "phase": phase, "observer": os.getpid(), "deadline_mono": deadline,
             "deadline_role": deadline_role, "mono_start": time.monotonic(), "mono_end": None, "attempts": 0,
             "first_observation": None, "last_observation": None, "errors": [], "matched": False}
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        item = observe(pid, role, phase, deadline)
        proof["attempts"] += 1
        if proof["first_observation"] is None:
            proof["first_observation"] = item
        proof["last_observation"] = item
        if item["error"] is not None:
            proof["errors"].append(item)
            if len(proof["errors"]) >= 8:
                break  # Fail on a bounded evidence cap, never silently discard failed reads.
        elif predicate(item["identity"]):
            proof["matched"] = True
            break
        time.sleep(min(POLL_S, max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
    proof["mono_end"] = time.monotonic()
    return proof


def stat_signature(value):
    return (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_size, value.st_nlink, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)


def snapshot_fd(fd, path, cap, deadline):
    check_deadline(deadline, "before regular snapshot")
    before = os.fstat(fd)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_nlink != 1 or not 0 <= before.st_size <= cap:
        raise ValueError("not a bounded single-link regular file")
    raw = bytearray()
    while len(raw) < before.st_size:
        check_deadline(deadline, "regular snapshot read")
        part = os.pread(fd, min(65536, before.st_size - len(raw)), len(raw))
        if not part:
            raise OSError("short regular snapshot")
        raw.extend(part)
    if os.pread(fd, 1, before.st_size) or stat_signature(os.fstat(fd)) != stat_signature(before):
        raise ValueError("regular file changed during snapshot")
    check_deadline(deadline, "after regular snapshot")
    return {"path": path, "inode": [before.st_dev, before.st_ino], "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            "bytes": len(raw), "nlink": before.st_nlink}, bytes(raw)


def read_regular_at(rootfd, name, path, deadline):
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=rootfd)
    try:
        facts, raw = snapshot_fd(fd, path, SMALL, deadline)
        named = os.stat(name, dir_fd=rootfd, follow_symlinks=False)
        if [named.st_dev, named.st_ino] != facts["inode"] or not stat.S_ISREG(named.st_mode) or named.st_nlink != 1:
            raise ValueError("regular pathname replaced during read")
        return facts, raw
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def anchor_schema(value, path):
    return (isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"path", "inode"} and value["path"] == path and
            isinstance(value["inode"], list) and len(value["inode"]) == 2 and
            all(integer(v) and v >= 0 for v in value["inode"]))


def target_schema(value, path):
    return (isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"path", "inode", "sha256", "bytes", "nlink"} and
            anchor_schema({"path": value["path"], "inode": value["inode"]}, path) and hex64(value["sha256"]) and
            integer(value["bytes"]) and 0 < value["bytes"] <= SMALL and integer(value["nlink"]) and value["nlink"] == 1)


def verify_anchors(run, rfd, ofd, expected_run, expected_out, deadline):
    fresh = directory(run, deadline)
    fresh_out = None
    try:
        fresh_out = os.open("out", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fresh)
        actual_run, actual_out = {"path": run, "inode": inode(rfd)}, {"path": run + "/out", "inode": inode(ofd)}
        if not typed_equal(actual_run, expected_run) or not typed_equal(actual_out, expected_out) or \
                not typed_equal(inode(fresh), expected_run["inode"]) or \
                not typed_equal(inode(fresh_out), expected_out["inode"]) or actual_run["inode"][0] != actual_out["inode"][0]:
            raise ValueError("ORIGINAL_APPROVED_DIRECTORY_ANCHOR_CHANGED")
        check_deadline(deadline, "anchor verification")
        return actual_run, actual_out
    finally:
        if fresh_out is not None:
            os.close(fresh_out)
        os.close(fresh)


def mutate_original(name, run, rfd, ofd, manifest, protocol, deadline):
    keys = {"kind", "scenario", "preparation_sha256", "run", "output_root", "target"}
    target_path = run + ("/pinned-scratch.txt" if name == "mutate_pin" else "/out/launch.json")
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or set(manifest) != keys or manifest["kind"] != "qualification-creation-manifest-v1" or \
            manifest["scenario"] != name or not hex64(manifest["preparation_sha256"]) or \
            not anchor_schema(manifest["run"], run) or not anchor_schema(manifest["output_root"], run + "/out") or \
            not target_schema(manifest["target"], target_path):
        raise ValueError("CREATION_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_OR_FIXED_PATH")
    actual_run, actual_out = verify_anchors(run, rfd, ofd, manifest["run"], manifest["output_root"], deadline)
    prep_facts, prep_raw = read_regular_at(rfd, "preparation.json", run + "/preparation.json", deadline)
    if prep_facts["sha256"] != manifest["preparation_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("APPROVED_PREPARATION_SHA256_MISMATCH")
    prep = parse_json(prep_raw)
    prep_keys = {"kind", "scenario", "run", "output_root", "fixture", "source_pins", "python", "allocation", "negative_control"}
    if not isinstance(prep, dict) or set(prep) != prep_keys or prep["kind"] != "qualification-creation-preparation-v1" or \
            prep["scenario"] != name or prep["negative_control"] is not True or not typed_equal(prep["run"], manifest["run"]) or \
            not typed_equal(prep["output_root"], manifest["output_root"]):
        raise ValueError("APPROVED_PREPARATION_SEMANTICS")
    pins = prep["source_pins"]
    if not isinstance(pins, dict) or set(pins) != {"supervisor", "child", "writer", "checker"} or any(
            not isinstance(v, dict) or set(v) != {"path", "sha256"} or not isinstance(v["path"], str) or
            not v["path"].startswith("/") or os.path.normpath(v["path"]) != v["path"] or not hex64(v["sha256"])
            for v in pins.values()) or any(pins[k]["path"] != path for k, path in SOURCE_PATHS.items()):
        raise ValueError("APPROVED_PREPARATION_SOURCE_PIN_METADATA")
    python, allocation = prep["python"], prep["allocation"]
    if not isinstance(python, dict) or set(python) != {"path", "sha256"} or not isinstance(python["path"], str) or \
            not python["path"].endswith("/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python") or \
            os.path.realpath(python["path"]) != python["path"] or python["path"] != os.path.realpath(sys.executable) or \
            not hex64(python["sha256"]):
        raise ValueError("APPROVED_PREPARATION_ACTUAL_PYTHON_APP")
    allocation_keys = {"bytes", "cpu_slots", "outstanding_reservations_bytes", "lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes"}
    if not isinstance(allocation, dict) or set(allocation) != allocation_keys or any(
            not integer(v) or not 0 <= v <= 1 << 60 for v in allocation.values()) or \
            allocation["bytes"] != 20971520 or allocation["cpu_slots"] != 1:
        raise ValueError("APPROVED_PREPARATION_ALLOCATION")
    target = manifest["target"]
    if name == "mutate_pin":
        if not typed_equal(prep["fixture"], target) or target["sha256"] != hashlib.sha256(FIXTURE).hexdigest() or target["bytes"] != len(FIXTURE):
            raise ValueError("ORIGINAL_CREATED_PIN_NOT_APPROVED_FIXTURE")
        rootfd, basename = rfd, "pinned-scratch.txt"
    else:
        if prep["fixture"] is not None:
            raise ValueError("LAUNCH_MUTATION_HAS_PIN_FIXTURE")
        rootfd, basename = ofd, "launch.json"
    # No O_CREAT, no pathname supplied by argv, no link/rename operations.
    fd = os.open(basename, os.O_RDWR | os.O_APPEND | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=rootfd)
    try:
        original, original_raw = snapshot_fd(fd, target_path, SMALL, deadline)
        if not typed_equal(original, target) or (name == "mutate_pin" and original_raw != FIXTURE):
            raise ValueError("ORIGINAL_CREATION_INODE_HASH_SIZE_LINK_MISMATCH")
        verify_anchors(run, rfd, ofd, manifest["run"], manifest["output_root"], deadline)
        named = os.stat(basename, dir_fd=rootfd, follow_symlinks=False)
        named_before = [named.st_dev, named.st_ino]
        if named_before != original["inode"] or not stat.S_ISREG(named.st_mode) or named.st_nlink != 1 or named.st_size != original["bytes"]:
            raise ValueError("ORIGINAL_TARGET_PATH_CHANGED_BEFORE_APPEND")
        # Re-snapshot on the SAME descriptor after anchor/name I/O and before the write.
        checked, checked_raw = snapshot_fd(fd, target_path, SMALL, deadline)
        if not typed_equal(checked, original) or checked_raw != original_raw:
            raise ValueError("ORIGINAL_TARGET_CHANGED_BEFORE_APPEND")
        mono_verified = time.monotonic()
        complete_write(fd, b"x", deadline)
        mono_append = time.monotonic()
        os.fsync(fd)
        check_deadline(deadline, "mutation fsync")
        mono_fsync = time.monotonic()
        after, after_raw = snapshot_fd(fd, target_path, SMALL + 1, deadline)
        named = os.stat(basename, dir_fd=rootfd, follow_symlinks=False)
        named_after = [named.st_dev, named.st_ino]
        if after["inode"] != original["inode"] or after["bytes"] != original["bytes"] + 1 or after_raw != original_raw + b"x" or \
                named_after != original["inode"] or named.st_nlink != 1 or not stat.S_ISREG(named.st_mode):
            raise ValueError("MUTATION_POST_APPEND_FACTS_CHANGED")
        return {"manifest": manifest, "manifest_sha256": protocol["creation_manifest_sha256"],
                "manifest_line_bytes": protocol["creation_line_bytes"], "preparation_sha256": prep_facts["sha256"],
                "preparation_facts": prep_facts, "run": actual_run, "output_root": actual_out,
                "original": original, "after": after, "name_inode_before": named_before, "name_inode_after": named_after,
                "append_bytes": 1, "mono_verified": mono_verified, "mono_append": mono_append,
                "mono_fsync_completed": mono_fsync, "mono_after_verified": time.monotonic()}
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def task_observation(pid, deadline):
    before = observe(pid, "main", "rss_measurement_before", deadline)
    record = {"pid": pid, "identity_before": before, "identity_after": None, "rss_bytes": None,
              "mono_start": time.monotonic(), "mono_end": None, "error": None}
    try:
        if before["identity"] is None:
            raise ValueError("RSS_IDENTITY_BEFORE_UNAVAILABLE")
        raw = pidinfo(pid, 4, 96, deadline)
        rss = struct.unpack_from("=Q", raw, 8)[0]
        after = observe(pid, "main", "rss_measurement_after", deadline)
        record["identity_after"] = after
        if after["identity"] is None or fingerprint(before["identity"]) != fingerprint(after["identity"]):
            raise ValueError("RSS_IDENTITY_BRACKET_CHANGED")
        record["rss_bytes"] = rss
    except Exception as error:
        record["error"] = repr(error)
    record["mono_end"] = time.monotonic()
    return record


def intermediate_report(name, reportfd, coop, reserve):
    deadline, join_deadline, inner_deadline = coop["mono_life_deadline"], coop["mono_join_deadline"], coop["mono_inner_deadline"]
    report = {"kind": INTERMEDIATE_KIND, "scenario": name, "intermediate": os.getpid(), "mono_module_entry": START_MONO,
              "mono_life_deadline": deadline, "cooperative": coop, "grandchild": None, "descendants": [], "joins": [],
              "identity_waits": [], "ownership_edges": [], "transports": {}, "evidence_failures": [], "error": None}
    try:
        if name == "ownership_double":
            os.setsid()
        own = observe(os.getpid(), "intermediate", "self_post_setup", inner_deadline)
        report["descendants"].append(own)
        if own["identity"] is None:
            raise ValueError("INTERMEDIATE_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE")
        if name == "zombie_hold":
            def zombie():
                os.close(reportfd)
            kid = fork_body(zombie, deadline)
            report["grandchild"] = kid
            held = identity_wait(kid, "zombie", "zombie_hold_start", coop, "mono_inner_deadline",
                                 lambda p: p["status"] == SZOMB)
            report["identity_waits"].append(held)
            if held["last_observation"] is not None:
                report["descendants"].append(held["last_observation"])
            if not held["matched"] or held["errors"]:
                report["evidence_failures"].append("ZOMBIE_HELD_IDENTITY_NOT_PROVED")
            hold_start = time.monotonic()
            hold_until = min(hold_start + 3.0, inner_deadline - reserve)
            sleep_to(hold_until)
            end = observe(kid, "zombie", "zombie_hold_end", inner_deadline)
            report["descendants"].append(end)
            first = held["last_observation"]["identity"] if held["last_observation"] is not None else None
            if first is None or end["identity"] is None or end["identity"]["status"] != SZOMB or fingerprint(first) != fingerprint(end["identity"]):
                report["evidence_failures"].append("ZOMBIE_HOLD_END_IDENTITY_NOT_PROVED")
            report["zombie_hold"] = {"mono_start": hold_start, "mono_hold_until": hold_until, "mono_end": time.monotonic()}
            # Inner zombie join: observer is this intermediate incarnation, target the held zombie incarnation.
            joined = join_child(kid, "zombie", coop, own["identity"], first)
            report["joins"].append(joined)
            if not join_ok(joined):
                report["evidence_failures"].append("ZOMBIE_JOIN_UNRESOLVED_OR_NONZERO")
        else:
            exec_read, exec_write = os.pipe()
            gate_read, gate_write = os.pipe()
            os.set_inheritable(exec_write, False)
            def exec_descendant():
                os.close(exec_read)
                os.close(gate_write)
                os.close(reportfd)
                try:
                    gate, gate_proof = read_pipe(gate_read, 1, coop, "mono_inner_deadline")
                    os.close(gate_read)
                    if gate != b"S" or not gate_proof["eof"] or gate_proof["error"] is not None:
                        raise ValueError("EXEC_START_GATE_REFUSED")
                    os.chdir("/")
                    devnull = os.open("/dev/null", os.O_RDWR)
                    for standard in (0, 1, 2):
                        os.dup2(devnull, standard)
                    os.closerange(3, exec_write)
                    os.closerange(exec_write + 1, 65536)
                    check_deadline(deadline, "before fixed sleep exec")
                    remaining = max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic())
                    os.execv("/bin/sleep", ["sleep", "%.6f" % remaining])
                    raise RuntimeError("exec unexpectedly returned")
                except BaseException as error:
                    try:
                        complete_write(exec_write, ("EXEC_ERROR %r\n" % error).encode()[:2048], deadline)
                    except BaseException:
                        pass
                    raise
            kid = fork_body(exec_descendant, deadline)
            report["grandchild"] = kid
            os.close(exec_write)
            os.close(gate_read)
            try:
                pre, edge = edge_observation(kid, "exec_descendant", "pre_exec", inner_deadline)
                report["descendants"].append(pre)
                report["ownership_edges"].append(edge)
                if pre["identity"] is None or not edge["current_parent_verified"]:
                    report["evidence_failures"].append("PRE_EXEC_CURRENT_PARENT_NOT_PROVED")
                gate = write_pipe(gate_write, b"S", coop, "mono_inner_deadline")
                report["transports"]["exec_start_gate"] = gate
            finally:
                os.close(gate_write)
            if gate["error"] is not None:
                report["evidence_failures"].append("EXEC_START_GATE_NOT_RETURNED")
                raise ValueError("EXEC_START_GATE_WRITE_FAILED")
            try:
                exec_raw, exec_proof = read_pipe(exec_read, 2048, coop, "mono_inner_deadline")
                report["transports"]["exec_status"] = exec_proof
            finally:
                os.close(exec_read)
            # Exec is proved only by an error-free, empty, EOF-terminated close-on-exec status pipe. Any byte, read
            # error or missing EOF is recorded and stops before a native sleep identity can be offered as exec proof.
            if exec_raw or not exec_proof["eof"] or exec_proof["error"] is not None:
                report["evidence_failures"].append("EXEC_STATUS_NOT_ERROR_FREE_EMPTY_EOF")
                raise ValueError("FIXED_SLEEP_EXEC_NOT_PROVED")
            post = identity_wait(kid, "exec_descendant", "post_exec_pre_reparent", coop, "mono_inner_deadline",
                                 lambda p: p["comm"] == "sleep" and p["ppid"] == os.getpid() and p["status"] != SZOMB)
            report["identity_waits"].append(post)
            if post["last_observation"] is not None:
                report["descendants"].append(post["last_observation"])
            if not post["matched"] or post["errors"]:
                report["evidence_failures"].append("POST_EXEC_INCARNATION_NOT_PROVED")
            if post["matched"]:
                current, edge = edge_observation(kid, "exec_descendant", "post_exec_current_parent", inner_deadline)
                report["descendants"].append(current)
                report["ownership_edges"].append(edge)
                if current["identity"] is None or not edge["current_parent_verified"]:
                    report["evidence_failures"].append("POST_EXEC_CURRENT_PARENT_NOT_PROVED")
    except BaseException as error:
        report["error"] = repr(error)
        report["evidence_failures"].append("INTERMEDIATE_BODY_ERROR")
    try:
        # Copy every included observation/join/poll/transport FIRST; only then take this report's own timestamp.
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(report)
        snapshot["mono_output"] = time.monotonic()
        data = json_line(snapshot)
        if len(data) > REPORT_CAP:
            raise ValueError("intermediate report cap")
        complete_write(reportfd, data, join_deadline)
    finally:
        os.close(reportfd)
    if report["evidence_failures"]:
        raise ValueError("INTERMEDIATE_REPORTED_FAILURE " + ",".join(report["evidence_failures"]))


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3 or sys.argv[1] not in SCENARIOS:
        return 2
    name, life = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2])
    if not math.isfinite(life) or not 1 <= life <= 120:
        return 2
    deadline = START_MONO + life
    # These are earlier ABSOLUTE cutoffs inside the original life, never now+life; forks inherit them unchanged.
    reserve = min(0.25, life / 8.0)
    coop = {"mono_life_deadline": deadline, "mono_work_end": deadline - 2 * reserve,
            "mono_join_deadline": deadline - reserve, "mono_inner_deadline": deadline - 3 * reserve,
            "poll_interval_s": POLL_S, "deadline_extended": False}
    work_end, join_deadline = coop["mono_work_end"], coop["mono_join_deadline"]
    try:
        protocol, manifest = wait_go(name, join_deadline)
    except Exception as error:
        complete_write(2, ("QUAL_CHILD_PROTOCOL_REFUSED %r\n" % error).encode(), deadline)
        return 6
    run = QROOT + "/" + name
    rfd = directory(run, deadline)
    ofd = None
    state = {"descendants": [], "joins": [], "identity_waits": [], "ownership_edges": [],
             "transports": {}, "evidence_failures": []}
    result_attempted = False
    main_observation = observe(os.getpid(), "main", "post_go", deadline)
    if main_observation["identity"] is None:
        state["evidence_failures"].append("MAIN_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE")
    def report_object(extra):
        # Copy every included observation/join/poll/transport FIRST; only then take this report's own timestamp.
        obj = copy.deepcopy({"child": CHILD, "scenario": name, "pid": os.getpid(), "pgid": os.getpgrp(),
                             "ppid": os.getppid(), "negative_control": name not in ("ok", "rc_nonzero"),
                             "mono_module_entry": START_MONO, "epoch_module_entry": START_EPOCH,
                             "mono_life_deadline": deadline, "stdin_protocol": protocol,
                             "main_identity": main_observation["identity"],
                             "main_identity_observed_mono": main_observation["observed_mono"],
                             "main_identity_observation": main_observation, "cooperative": coop, **state, **extra})
        obj["mono_output"] = time.monotonic()
        return obj
    def result(extra=None):
        nonlocal result_attempted
        result_attempted = True
        final = observe(os.getpid(), "main", "output", deadline)
        if final["identity"] is None:
            state["evidence_failures"].append("MAIN_OUTPUT_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE")
        create_json(ofd, "child-out.json", report_object(dict(extra or {}, main_identity_at_output=final)), deadline)
    def status(normal=0):
        return 1 if state["evidence_failures"] else normal
    try:
        ofd = os.open("out", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=rfd)
        if name in ("ok", "go_unlisted", "rc_nonzero", "date_fault", "helper_overrun", "helper_group", "helper_eof"):
            result()
            if name == "ok":
                complete_write(1, b"line 1\nline 2\nline 3\n", deadline)
            return status(3 if name == "rc_nonzero" else 0)
        if name == "missing_output":
            complete_write(1, b"no output written\n", deadline)
            return status()
        if name in MUTATIONS:
            creation = mutate_original(name, run, rfd, ofd, manifest, protocol, deadline)
            result({"creation": creation, "target_inode": creation["original"]["inode"],
                    "size_before": creation["original"]["bytes"]})
            return status()
        if name == "stray_file":
            result()
            fd = os.open("stray.txt", os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, 0o644, dir_fd=ofd)
            try:
                complete_write(fd, b"undeclared file\n", deadline)
                os.fsync(fd)
                check_deadline(deadline, "stray fsync")
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
            return status()
        if name == "flood":
            os.set_blocking(1, False)
            line = b"x" * 65535 + b"\n"
            view = memoryview(line)
            while time.monotonic() < work_end:
                try:
                    n = os.write(1, view)
                    if n <= 0:
                        raise OSError("zero-progress flood write")
                    view = view[n:] if n < len(view) else memoryview(line)
                except BlockingIOError:
                    time.sleep(min(0.005, max(0.0, work_end - time.monotonic())))
            return status()
        if name == "busy":
            ids = report_object({"busy_pid": os.getpid(), "mono_before_work": time.monotonic()})
            complete_write(1, b"IDS " + json_line(ids), deadline)
            spin_to(work_end)
            return status()
        if name == "rss":
            before = task_observation(os.getpid(), deadline)
            if before["error"] is not None:
                raise ValueError("RSS_BASELINE_NOT_PROVED " + repr(before))
            # Briefly defer the one ordinary TERM only until the bounded allocation/touch/
            # measurement/IDS write completes; then restore its DEFAULT disposition/mask.
            # This prevents an RSS trip racing away its own PID-specific evidence.
            old_mask = signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK, {signal.SIGTERM})
            try:
                mono_allocate = time.monotonic()
                block = bytearray(320 * 1024 * 1024)
                touch_writes = 0
                for index in range(0, len(block), 4096):
                    block[index] = 1
                    touch_writes += 1
                    if touch_writes % 1024 == 0:
                        check_deadline(work_end, "RSS touch")
                after = task_observation(os.getpid(), deadline)
                if after["error"] is not None:
                    raise ValueError("RSS_AFTER_TOUCH_NOT_PROVED " + repr(after))
                ids = report_object({"rss_pid": os.getpid(), "allocated": len(block), "touched_bytes": len(block),
                                     "touch_stride": 4096, "touch_writes": touch_writes,
                                     "touch_write_bytes": touch_writes, "page_size": mmap.PAGESIZE,
                                     "rss_before_bytes": before["rss_bytes"], "rss_after_bytes": after["rss_bytes"],
                                     "rss_delta_bytes": after["rss_bytes"] - before["rss_bytes"],
                                     "rss_before": before, "rss_after": after,
                                     "mono_before_allocation": mono_allocate, "mono_after_touch": time.monotonic(),
                                     "term_masked_for_evidence": True})
                complete_write(1, b"IDS " + json_line(ids), deadline)
            finally:
                signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_SETMASK, old_mask)
            sleep_to(work_end)
            return status()
        if name == "busy2":
            gate_read, gate_write = os.pipe()
            def spinner():
                os.close(gate_write)
                try:
                    raw, proof = read_pipe(gate_read, 1, coop, "mono_work_end")
                finally:
                    os.close(gate_read)
                if raw != b"S" or not proof["eof"] or proof["error"] is not None:
                    raise ValueError("BUSY_START_GATE_REFUSED")
                spin_to(work_end)
            kid = fork_body(spinner, deadline)
            os.close(gate_read)
            observed = observe(kid, "busy_spinner", "pre_spin", join_deadline)
            state["descendants"].append(observed)
            if observed["identity"] is None:
                state["evidence_failures"].append("BUSY_SPINNER_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE")
            ids = report_object({"busy_pids": [os.getpid(), kid], "mono_before_work": time.monotonic(),
                                 "mono_work_end": work_end, "busy_gate": "not_released_before_identity_and_IDS"})
            try:
                complete_write(1, b"IDS " + json_line(ids), deadline)
                if not state["evidence_failures"]:
                    gate = write_pipe(gate_write, b"S", coop, "mono_join_deadline")
                    state["transports"]["busy_start_gate"] = gate
                    if gate["error"] is not None:
                        raise ValueError("BUSY_START_GATE_WRITE_FAILED")
            finally:
                os.close(gate_write)
            if not state["evidence_failures"]:
                spin_to(work_end)
            joined = join_child(kid, "busy_spinner", coop, main_observation["identity"], observed["identity"])
            state["joins"].append(joined)
            if not join_ok(joined):
                state["evidence_failures"].append("BUSY_JOIN_UNRESOLVED_OR_NONZERO")
            result({"grandchild": kid, "busy_pids": [os.getpid(), kid]})
            return status()
        if name in ("ownership_group", "ownership_slow", "ownership_fast"):

def hex64(x):
    return type(x) is str and len(x) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in x)


def typed_equal(left, right):
    """PURE. Same body as the pinned supervisor's typed_equal: exact JSON structure and scalar types recursively, so a
    bool never aliases an integer (true != 1, false != 0) and an integer never aliases a float."""
    if type(left) is not type(right):
        return False
    if isinstance(left, dict):
        return set(left) == set(right) and all(typed_equal(left[k], right[k]) for k in left)
    if isinstance(left, list):
        return len(left) == len(right) and all(typed_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right))
    return left == right


def fixed_source_pins(source_pins):
    """PURE. Exact {supervisor,child,writer,checker} -> {path,sha256} at the fixed paths; the supervisor must be the
    SUPERVISOR_SHA candidate bytes. Other digests are the actual bytes the caller hashed; the parent's external
    approval trusts them. Paths and the supervisor digest bind by typed_equal; other digests are exact hex64 str."""
    if type(source_pins) is not dict or set(source_pins) != set(SOURCES) or any(
            type(source_pins[k]) is not dict or set(source_pins[k]) != {"path", "sha256"} or
            not typed_equal(source_pins[k]["path"], SOURCES[k]) or not hex64(source_pins[k]["sha256"])
            for k in SOURCES):
        raise ValueError("source pins are not exactly the four fixed package source paths")
    if not typed_equal(source_pins["supervisor"]["sha256"], SUPERVISOR_SHA):
        raise ValueError("supervisor bytes are not the pinned SUPERVISOR_SHA source candidate")
    return {k: {"path": SOURCES[k], "sha256": source_pins[k]["sha256"]} for k in SOURCES}

    """PURE shared validation for preparation_for/config_for/go_entry_for; returns the exact allocation object, whose
    four fields are JSON integers (type int, never bool)."""
    if name not in SC:
        raise ValueError("unknown qualification scenario")
    fixed_source_pins(source_pins)
    if type(python) is not str or not python.startswith("/") or os.path.normpath(python) != python or \
            not python.endswith(PYTHON_SUFFIX) or not hex64(python_sha256):
        raise ValueError("interpreter pin is not an actual Python.app executable digest")
    for total, top in ((outstanding, 1 << 60), (lane_outstanding, LANE_CEILING)):

            raise ValueError("parent outstanding reservation total out of range")
    return {"bytes": RESERVATION, "cpu_slots": 2 if name == "busy2" else 1,
            "outstanding_reservations_bytes": outstanding, "lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes": lane_outstanding}

            "allocation": allocation, "negative_control": name not in POSITIVE}

def go_entry_for(name, python, python_sha256, outstanding, lane_outstanding, source_pins, preparation_sha256,
                 creation_channel):
    """PURE. Exact GO configs entry for config_for(...) with the same arguments, derived exactly as the pinned
    supervisor's authorization_io derives its expected object (BOUND_KEYS[:5] from the config, BOUND_KEYS[5:] from its
    admission), then every field is verified to have its exact BOUND_TYPES JSON type with str list/dict members, so the
    entry can never carry true for cpu_slots 1, false for a zero total or 60.0 for max_wall_s 60. Compare with
    typed_equal."""
    cfg = config_for(name, python, python_sha256, outstanding, lane_outstanding, source_pins, preparation_sha256,
                     creation_channel)
    entry = {k: cfg[k] for k in BOUND_KEYS[:5]}
    entry.update({k: cfg["admission"][k] for k in BOUND_KEYS[5:]})
    for k in BOUND_KEYS:
        v = entry[k]
        if type(v) is not BOUND_TYPES[k] or (type(v) is list and any(type(x) is not str for x in v)) or \
                (type(v) is dict and any(type(a) is not str or type(b) is not str for a, b in v.items())):
            raise ValueError("GO entry field is not its exact bound JSON type: " + k)
    return entry


def go_configs_for(name, config_sha256, entry):
    """PURE. Exact GO "configs" value: {} for go_unlisted (its declared negative lists no config), otherwise exactly
    {config_sha256: entry} with entry = go_entry_for(...). Compare with typed_equal, never ==."""
    if name not in SC or not hex64(config_sha256) or type(entry) is not dict or set(entry) != set(BOUND_KEYS):
        raise ValueError("GO configs need this scenario, an actual config digest and its exact bound entry")
    return {} if name == "go_unlisted" else {config_sha256: entry}


def marker_for(source_pins):
    """PURE. Exact QROOT/package-root.json object agreed with the checker: fixed package identity plus the ACTUAL
    source digests hashed at the first authorized preparation; no static own/checker digest constant exists here."""
    return {"kind": MARKER_KIND, "package": "v9", "qroot": QROOT,
            "source_pins": fixed_source_pins(source_pins)}


def negative_designation(name):
    """PURE. Explicit negative authority the parent must supply: exact approval flags and the exact three-key GO
    qualification_negative object (None means the GO omits it). Every flag is a bool, never 0 or 1."""
    if name not in SC:
        raise ValueError("unknown qualification scenario")
    kind = "mutation" if name in MUTATIONS else "ownership" if name in NEGATIVE_PROCESS else \
        "helper_injection" if name in HELPER_INJECTIONS else None
    go = None if kind is None else {"scenario": name, "kind": kind, "creation_channel": name in MUTATIONS}
    return {"negative_control": name not in POSITIVE, "go_qualification_negative": go,
            "approval": {"ownership_negative": name in NEGATIVE_PROCESS,
                         "helper_injection": name in HELPER_INJECTIONS,
                         "mutation_negative": name in MUTATIONS}}


def canonical(obj):
    return (json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, indent=1, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()


class Budget:
    """Cooperative monotonic I/O budget: refusal only, never a signal, kill or tool timeout; no value is recorded."""

    def __init__(self, seconds):
        self.end = time.monotonic() + seconds

    def check(self, where):
        if time.monotonic() > self.end:
            raise OSError("preparation I/O budget exceeded " + where)


def decimal(text):
    if not (0 < len(text) <= 20 and text.isascii() and text.isdigit() and (text == "0" or text[0] != "0")):
        raise ValueError("reservation totals must be canonical nonnegative decimal integers")
    return int(text)


def open_directory(path, budget):
    """New descriptor by no-follow component traversal from /; every component must be a real directory."""
    if not path.startswith("/") or path == "/" or os.path.normpath(path) != path:
        raise ValueError("directory path is not a normalized absolute path")
    fd = os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        for component in path[1:].split("/"):
            if component in ("", ".", ".."):
                raise ValueError("invalid directory component")
            nxt = os.open(component, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
            os.close(fd)
            fd = nxt
            budget.check("directory traversal")
        return fd
    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)
        raise


def read_bounded(dir_fd, name, cap, budget, keep=False):
    """Bounded no-follow regular-file read relative to a retained directory descriptor; any change refuses."""
    st = os.stat(name, dir_fd=dir_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or not 0 <= st.st_size <= cap:
        raise OSError("not a bounded regular file " + name)
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=dir_fd)
    h, parts, got = hashlib.sha256(), [], 0
    try:
        fs = os.fstat(fd)
        if (fs.st_dev, fs.st_ino, fs.st_size) != (st.st_dev, st.st_ino, st.st_size):
            raise OSError("file changed at open " + name)
        while got < st.st_size:
            b = os.read(fd, min(1 << 20, st.st_size - got))
            if not b:
                raise OSError("short read " + name)
            h.update(b)
            got += len(b)
            if keep:
                parts.append(b)
            budget.check("read " + name)
        tail = os.read(fd, 1)
        end = os.fstat(fd)
        if tail or (end.st_size, end.st_mtime_ns) != (st.st_size, st.st_mtime_ns):
            raise OSError("file changed during read " + name)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    facts = {"sha256": h.hexdigest(), "inode": [st.st_dev, st.st_ino], "bytes": got, "nlink": st.st_nlink}
    return facts, (b"".join(parts) if keep else None)


def make_directory(parent_fd, name, device, budget):
    """Exclusive mkdir; its creation identity is fstat of the no-follow descriptor opened right after it."""
    os.mkdir(name, 0o755, dir_fd=parent_fd)
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent_fd)
    try:
        st = os.fstat(fd)
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) or st.st_dev != device or st.st_uid != os.geteuid() or os.listdir(fd):
            raise OSError("created directory is not a fresh owned empty same-volume directory " + name)
        budget.check("mkdir " + name)
    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)
        raise
    return fd, [st.st_dev, st.st_ino]


def create_exclusive(dir_fd, name, data, mode, budget):
    """Exclusive no-follow creation. Recorded inode/size/nlink are fstat of the CREATED descriptor BEFORE close and
    the content is read back on that descriptor; a later no-follow read must still find exactly that file."""
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, mode, dir_fd=dir_fd)
    try:
        view = memoryview(data)
        while view:
            n = os.write(fd, view)
            if n <= 0:
                raise OSError("zero-progress write " + name)
            view = view[n:]
            budget.check("write " + name)
        os.fsync(fd)
        st = os.fstat(fd)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_size != len(data) or st.st_nlink != 1 or \
                os.pread(fd, len(data) + 1, 0) != data:
            raise OSError("created descriptor facts differ " + name)
        created = {"sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "inode": [st.st_dev, st.st_ino],
                   "bytes": st.st_size, "nlink": st.st_nlink}
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    if not typed_equal(read_bounded(dir_fd, name, len(data), budget)[0], created):
        raise OSError("created file changed after close " + name)
    return created


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 5:
        raise ValueError("usage: SCENARIO ACTUAL_PYTHON_APP OUTSTANDING_BYTES LANE_OUTSTANDING_BYTES")
    name, python = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    outstanding, lane_outstanding = decimal(sys.argv[3]), decimal(sys.argv[4])
    if name not in SC:
        raise ValueError("unknown qualification scenario")
    if os.path.abspath(__file__) != SOURCES["writer"]:
        raise ValueError("writer must execute from its fixed package path")
    if not python.endswith(PYTHON_SUFFIX) or os.path.realpath(python) != python:
        raise ValueError("interpreter is not the actual non-launcher Python.app executable")
    budget = Budget(IO_BUDGET_S)
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        def held(fd):
            stack.callback(os.close, fd)
            return fd

        lane = held(open_directory(LANE, budget))
        lane_st = os.fstat(lane)
        code = held(os.open("code", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=lane))
        actual = {}
        for key, path in SOURCES.items():
            facts = read_bounded(code, os.path.basename(path), SOURCE_CAP, budget)[0]
            actual[key] = {"path": path, "sha256": facts["sha256"]}
        source_pins = fixed_source_pins(actual)
        interpreter = held(open_directory(os.path.dirname(python), budget))
        python_sha = read_bounded(interpreter, os.path.basename(python), PIN_CAP, budget)[0]["sha256"]
        allocation = pinned_inputs(name, source_pins, python, python_sha, outstanding, lane_outstanding)
        marker = marker_for(source_pins)
        negative = negative_designation(name)
        # Arguments, fixed paths and actual source/interpreter digests are validated; creation starts only here.
        created_root = True
        try:
            os.mkdir(PACKAGE, 0o755, dir_fd=lane)
        except FileExistsError:
            created_root = False
        qfd = held(os.open(PACKAGE, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=lane))
        qst = os.fstat(qfd)
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(qst.st_mode) or qst.st_dev != lane_st.st_dev or qst.st_uid != os.geteuid():
            raise OSError("package root is not an owned same-volume directory")
        if created_root:
            if os.listdir(qfd):
                raise OSError("newly created package root is not empty")
            root = create_exclusive(qfd, "package-root.json", canonical(marker), 0o444, budget)
        else:
            root, raw = read_bounded(qfd, "package-root.json", SOURCE_CAP, budget, keep=True)
            if raw != canonical(marker) or root["nlink"] != 1:
                raise ValueError("existing package root marker is not this package's actual source identity")
        try:
            rfd, run_inode = make_directory(qfd, name, lane_st.st_dev, budget)
        except FileExistsError:
            raise ValueError("RUN already exists; preparation is fresh-only and never reuses a run") from None
        held(rfd)
        ofd, out_inode = make_directory(rfd, "out", lane_st.st_dev, budget)
        held(ofd)
        tfd, tmp_inode = make_directory(rfd, "tmp", lane_st.st_dev, budget)
        held(tfd)
        fixture_inode = None
        if name == "mutate_pin":
            fixture_inode = create_exclusive(rfd, "pinned-scratch.txt", FIXTURE, 0o644, budget)["inode"]
        prep = preparation_for(name, run_inode, out_inode, fixture_inode, source_pins, python, python_sha,
                               outstanding, lane_outstanding)
        prepared = create_exclusive(rfd, "preparation.json", canonical(prep), 0o444, budget)
        channel = creation_channel_for(name, prepared["sha256"])
        cfg = config_for(name, python, python_sha, outstanding, lane_outstanding, source_pins, prepared["sha256"],
                         channel)
        # The exact-type GO entry is established before config.json exists; a type refusal creates no config.
        entry = go_entry_for(name, python, python_sha, outstanding, lane_outstanding, source_pins, prepared["sha256"],
                             channel)
        configured = create_exclusive(rfd, "config.json", canonical(cfg), 0o444, budget)
        os.fsync(rfd)
        os.fsync(qfd)
        if created_root:
            os.fsync(lane)
        run = QROOT + "/" + name
        for path, ident in ((LANE, [lane_st.st_dev, lane_st.st_ino]), (QROOT, [qst.st_dev, qst.st_ino]),
                            (run, run_inode), (run + "/out", out_inode), (run + "/tmp", tmp_inode)):
            fd = open_directory(path, budget)
            try:
                st = os.fstat(fd)
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
            if not typed_equal([st.st_dev, st.st_ino], ident):
                raise OSError("anchor changed during preparation " + path)
        inventory = {"out", "tmp", "preparation.json", "config.json"}
        if fixture_inode is not None:
            inventory.add("pinned-scratch.txt")
        if set(os.listdir(rfd)) != inventory or os.listdir(ofd) or os.listdir(tfd):
            raise OSError("RUN inventory differs or out/TMPDIR is not empty")
        budget.check("final anchor verification")
        print(json.dumps({
            "kind": "qualification-preparation-output-v1", "scenario": name, "item": ITEM, "run": run,
            "tmpdir": {"path": run + "/tmp", "inode": tmp_inode},
            "package_root": {"path": QROOT, "created": created_root, "marker": marker, "sha256": root["sha256"],
                             "inode": root["inode"]},
            "preparation": {"path": run + "/preparation.json", "sha256": prepared["sha256"],
                            "inode": prepared["inode"], "bytes": prepared["bytes"], "content": prep},
            "config": {"path": run + "/config.json", "sha256": configured["sha256"], "inode": configured["inode"],
                       "bytes": configured["bytes"], "content": cfg},
            "allocation": allocation, "go_entry": entry,
            "go_configs": go_configs_for(name, configured["sha256"], entry),
            "go_qualification_negative": negative["go_qualification_negative"],
            "approval_requirements": dict(negative["approval"], kind=APPROVAL_KIND, scenario=name,
                                          config_sha256=configured["sha256"], preparation_sha256=prepared["sha256"],
                                          sources=source_pins, python={"path": python, "sha256": python_sha},
                                          allocation=allocation),
            "negative_control": negative["negative_control"]},
            sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":

            "fault_injection": {FAULTS[name]: True} if name in FAULTS else {},
            "creation_channel": creation_channel}


class Invalid(Exception):
    pass


def integer(x, lower=None):
    return isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool) and (lower is None or x >= lower)


def finite(x):
    try:
        return isinstance(x, (float, int)) and not isinstance(x, bool) and math.isfinite(x)
    except OverflowError:
        return False


def pairs(kv):
    out = {}
    for k, v in kv:
        if k in out:
            raise Invalid("duplicate JSON key")
        out[k] = v
    return out


def floating(s):
    n = float(s)
    if not math.isfinite(n):
        raise Invalid("nonfinite numeric literal")
    return n


def constant(s):
    raise Invalid("nonfinite JSON constant")


DECODER = json.JSONDecoder(object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_float=floating, parse_constant=constant)


def decode(raw):
    return DECODER.decode(raw.decode())


def sequence(raw):
    text, at, objects = raw.decode(), 0, []
    while at < len(text):
        while at < len(text) and text[at].isspace():
            at += 1
        if at == len(text):
            break
        obj, at = DECODER.raw_decode(text, at)
        if not isinstance(obj, dict):
            raise Invalid("sample is not an object")
        objects.append(obj)
    return objects


def directory(path):
    fd = os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        for c in path.lstrip("/").split("/"):
            if c in ("", ".", ".."):
                raise Invalid("invalid directory component")
            nxt = os.open(c, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
            os.close(fd)
            fd = nxt
        return fd
    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)
        raise


def snapshot(fdroot, name, cap=64 << 20, optional=False):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
    def signature(s):
        return (s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_mode, s.st_size, s.st_nlink, s.st_mtime_ns, s.st_ctime_ns)
    try:
        st = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fdroot, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        if optional:
            return None
        raise
    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or not 0 <= st.st_size <= cap:
        raise Invalid("not a bounded regular file: " + name)
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=fdroot)
    try:
        s1 = os.fstat(fd)
        if signature(s1) != signature(st):
            raise Invalid("file changed at open")
        parts, n = [], 0
        while n < st.st_size:
            b = os.read(fd, min(1 << 20, st.st_size - n))
            if not b:
                raise Invalid("short read")
            parts.append(b)
            n += len(b)
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                raise Invalid("read deadline")
        tail, s2 = os.read(fd, 1), os.fstat(fd)
        named_end = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fdroot, follow_symlinks=False)
        if tail or signature(s2) != signature(st) or signature(named_end) != signature(st):
            raise Invalid("file changed during read")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    if time.monotonic() > deadline:
        raise Invalid("read completion deadline")
    raw = b"".join(parts)
    return {"raw": raw, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(raw),
            "inode": [st.st_dev, st.st_ino], "nlink": st.st_nlink, "birth_epoch": st.st_birthtime}


def absolute_snapshot(path, cap=64 << 20):
    fd = directory(os.path.dirname(path))
    try:
        return snapshot(fd, os.path.basename(path), cap)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def expectations(name):
    if name == "go_unlisted":
        return {"state": "NOT_LAUNCHED", "exit": 14, "rc": None, "loop": "NOT_STARTED", "failures": set(), "trips": [], "signal": None}
    if name in ("date_fault", "helper_overrun", "helper_group", "helper_eof"):
        unresolved = name in ("helper_group", "helper_eof")
        codes = {"HELPER_FAULT_INJECTED"} if name == "date_fault" else {"HELPER_CALL_FAILED"}
        if unresolved:
            codes.add("HELPER_OWNERSHIP_UNSETTLED")
        return {"state": "UNSETTLED" if unresolved else "NOT_LAUNCHED", "exit": 14,
                "rc": None, "loop": "NOT_STARTED", "failures": codes, "trips": [], "signal": None}
    if name in ("ok", "rc_nonzero", "zombie_hold"):
        return {"state": "SETTLED", "exit": 0, "rc": 3 if name == "rc_nonzero" else 0,
                "loop": "EXITED", "failures": set(), "trips": [], "signal": None}
    if name.startswith("ownership_"):
        codes = {"GRACE_EXPIRED_AFTER_CHILD_EXIT"}
        if name != "ownership_double":
            codes.add("STREAMS_OR_THREADS_NOT_CLOSED")
        return {"state": "UNSETTLED", "exit": 11, "rc": 0, "loop": "GRACE_EXPIRED_AFTER_CHILD_EXIT",
                "failures": codes, "trips": [], "signal": "reaped", "derive_exact_blocker_code": True}
    codes = {"missing_output": "REQUIRED_OUTPUT_MISSING", "mutate_pin": "PIN_CHANGED_OR_UNREADABLE",
             "mutate_evidence": "EVIDENCE_MUTATED", "stray_file": "UNDECLARED_ENTRIES"}
    if name in codes:
        return {"state": "UNSETTLED", "exit": 11, "rc": 0, "loop": "EXITED", "failures": {codes[name]}, "trips": [], "signal": "reaped"}
    if name in ("deadline", "flood", "busy2", "rss"):
        return {"state": "SETTLED", "exit": 0, "rc": -15, "loop": "EXITED", "failures": set(),
                "trips": [{"deadline": "DEADLINE", "flood": "STREAM_CAP", "busy2": "BUSY", "rss": "RSS"}[name]], "signal": "sent"}
    failures = {"GRACE_EXPIRED_AFTER_STOP_REQUEST", "CHILD_NOT_REAPED", "OWNED_LIVE", "STREAMS_OR_THREADS_NOT_CLOSED"}
    if name == "identity":
        failures.add("IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
    return {"state": "UNSETTLED", "exit": 11, "rc": None, "loop": "GRACE_EXPIRED_AFTER_STOP_REQUEST",
            "failures": failures, "trips": ["DEADLINE"], "signal": "injected" if name == "identity" else "sent"}


def hash_entry(s):
    return {k: s[k] for k in ("sha256", "bytes", "inode", "nlink")}


def helper_evidence(receipt, cfg, name):
    hs, log = receipt.get("helpers"), receipt.get("helper_log")
    if not isinstance(hs, list) or not isinstance(log, list) or not integer(receipt.get("helper_calls"), 0):
        return False
    if receipt["helper_calls"] != len(hs) or len(hs) > cfg["helper_budget"]["max_calls"] or any(
            not isinstance(e, dict) or not finite(e.get("mono_start")) or not finite(e.get("mono_end")) or
            e["mono_end"] < e["mono_start"] for e in log):
        return False
    allowed = {"OK", "REFUSED_FAILURE_CANCEL_OR_REENTRANCY"}
    if name == "go_unlisted":
        return hs == [] and receipt["helper_calls"] == 0 and receipt.get("end_date") is None and \
            log and all(e.get("outcome") == "REFUSED_NO_AUTHORIZATION" for e in log)
    if name == "date_fault":
        return hs == [] and receipt["helper_calls"] == 0 and receipt.get("admission", {}).get("date") is None and \
            receipt.get("end_date") is None and any(e.get("outcome") == "FAULT_BEFORE_SPAWN" for e in log) and \
            all(e.get("outcome") in allowed | {"FAULT_BEFORE_SPAWN"} for e in log)
    injected = name in ("helper_overrun", "helper_group", "helper_eof")
    if not hs or any(e.get("outcome") not in allowed | ({"FAILED"} if injected else set()) for e in log):
        return False
    if len({h.get("pid") for h in hs}) != len(hs) or (injected and len(hs) != 1):
        return False
    for h in hs:
        ident, proof = h.get("identity"), h.get("proof")
        if not isinstance(ident, dict) or not isinstance(proof, dict):
            return False
        if not (integer(h.get("pid"), 1) and ident.get("pid") == ident.get("pgid") == h["pid"] and
                integer(ident.get("uniqueid"), 1) and integer(ident.get("idversion")) and
                ident.get("euid") == ident.get("ruid") == receipt.get("uid") and
                h.get("initial_identity_valid") is True and h.get("leader_reaped") is True and
                h.get("wait_lost") is False and integer(h.get("rc")) and h.get("stdout_closed") is True and
                proof.get("complete") is True and proof.get("unproved_live") == [] and
                h.get("coverage_complete") is True and h.get("descendants_clear") is True and finite(h.get("mono_reaped")) and
                finite(h.get("mono_call_start")) and finite(h.get("mono_call_deadline")) and
                h["mono_call_start"] <= h["mono_reaped"] and h.get("spawn_error") is None and
                isinstance(h.get("term_attempted"), bool) and isinstance(h.get("launch_commit"), dict)):
            return False
        root_uid = ident["uniqueid"]
        roots = {o.get("identity", {}).get("uniqueid"): o.get("root") for o in receipt.get("owned_identities", [])}
        if any(roots.get(p.get("uniqueid")) == root_uid for p in proof.get("owned_live", [])):
            return False
        if name in ("helper_group", "helper_eof"):
            if not (h.get("settled") is False and h.get("clock_failed") is True and h.get("date") is None and h["rc"] == 0):
                return False
            if name == "helper_group" and not (h.get("group_clear") is False and h.get("eof_proved") is True):
                return False
            if name == "helper_eof" and not (h.get("group_clear") is True and h.get("eof_proved") is False):
                return False
        elif name == "helper_overrun":
            if not (h.get("clock_failed") is True and h.get("date") is None and h.get("settled") is True and
                    h.get("group_clear") is True and h.get("eof_proved") is True and
                    finite(h.get("mono_cleanup_start")) and h["mono_cleanup_start"] > h["mono_call_deadline"] and
                    finite(h.get("mono_cleanup_deadline")) and finite(h.get("mono_proof_complete")) and
                    h["mono_proof_complete"] <= h["mono_cleanup_deadline"]):
                return False
            if not (h["rc"] in (0, -15) and finite(h.get("mono_injection_start")) and finite(h.get("mono_injection_end")) and
                    h["mono_call_start"] <= h["mono_injection_start"] < h["mono_call_deadline"] < h["mono_injection_end"] <= h["mono_cleanup_start"]):
                return False
        else:
            try:
                raw = bytes.fromhex(h["capture_hex"])
                text = raw.decode("ascii").strip()
            except (ValueError, KeyError, UnicodeDecodeError):
                return False
            digits = text[:4] + text[5:7] + text[8:10] + text[11:13] + text[14:16] + text[17:19] + text[20:24]
            if not (h.get("settled") is True and h.get("clock_failed") is False and h.get("rc") == 0 and
                    h.get("group_clear") is True and h.get("eof_proved") is True and h.get("date") == text and
                    len(text) == 24 and len(raw) <= 256 and text[4] == text[7] == "-" and text[10] == "T" and
                    text[13] == text[16] == ":" and text[19] in "+-" and digits.isdigit() and
                    finite(h.get("mono_proof_complete")) and h["mono_proof_complete"] <= h["mono_call_deadline"]):
                return False
        identity(ident)
        linked = [e for e in log if e.get("pid") == h["pid"]]
        if len(linked) != 1 or linked[0].get("outcome") != ("FAILED" if injected else "OK"):
            return False
        sig = h.get("signal")
        if sig is not None:
            if not isinstance(sig, dict) or not isinstance(sig.get("sent"), bool):
                return False
            if "identity_observed" in sig:
                identity(sig["identity_observed"])
                if not finite(sig.get("mono_identity_observed")) or not finite(sig.get("mono_check")) or \
                        sig["mono_identity_observed"] < sig["mono_check"]:
                    return False
            if sig["sent"] and (sig.get("identity_ok") is not True or not finite(sig.get("mono_sent")) or
                    "identity_observed" not in sig or identity(sig["identity_observed"]) != identity(ident) or
                    not sig["mono_identity_observed"] <= sig["mono_sent"]):
                return False
        if h["rc"] == -15 and (sig is None or sig.get("sent") is not True):
            return False
    return True


def date_epoch(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise Invalid("date is not an actual helper string")
    parsed = datetime.datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
    if parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z") != text:
        raise Invalid("noncanonical actual date")
    return parsed.timestamp()


def same(a, b):
    return json.dumps(a, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) == \
        json.dumps(b, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


def identity(p):
    if not isinstance(p, dict) or set(p) != {"pid", "ppid", "pgid", "uniqueid", "idversion", "euid", "ruid", "status", "traced", "comm"} or not all(integer(p.get(k), 0) for k in
        ("pid", "ppid", "pgid", "uniqueid", "euid", "ruid", "status")) or not integer(p.get("idversion")) or \
            not -(1 << 31) <= p["idversion"] < 1 << 31 or \
            not all(p[k] > 0 for k in ("pid", "uniqueid")) or not isinstance(p.get("traced"), bool) or \
            not isinstance(p.get("comm"), str):
        raise Invalid("full process incarnation missing")
    return tuple(p[k] for k in ("pid", "uniqueid", "idversion", "euid", "ruid", "ppid", "pgid", "traced"))


def identity_form(p):
    return identity(p) + (p["comm"],)


def histories(view, baseuids):
    required = ("identity_history", "identity_events", "unproved_history", "coverage_history", "census_observations", "observation_attempts")
    if any(not isinstance(view.get(k), list) for k in required):
        raise Invalid("complete current/retained identity-event history missing")
    ih, events, uh, ch, cs, ats = (view[k] for k in required)
    if len(ih) > 8192 or len(uh) > 8192 or len(ch) > 16384 or len(cs) > 4096 or len(ats) > 4096:
        raise Invalid("history entry cap")
    if not integer(view.get("history_charge_bytes"), 0) or view["history_charge_bytes"] > 4 << 20 or \
            view.get("history_overflow") is not None or view.get("history_halted", False) is not False:
        raise Invalid("history cap/overflow or missing charged bytes")
    cutoff = view.get("mono_decision", view.get("mono_snapshot"))
    start = view.get("initial_fit", {}).get("start_mono")
    if not finite(cutoff) or not finite(start) or start > cutoff:
        raise Invalid("actual identity-event observation window missing")
    imap, by_uid, unknown_refs = {}, {}, {}
    for e in ih:
        first, last, variants = e.get("first_identity"), e.get("last_identity"), e.get("variants")
        identity(first)
        identity(last)
        uid = first["uniqueid"]
        if uid in imap or last["uniqueid"] != uid or first["pid"] != last["pid"] or \
                not integer(e.get("observations"), 1) or not isinstance(e.get("source"), str) or \
                not isinstance(variants, list) or not 1 <= len(variants) <= 64:
            raise Invalid("identity ledger malformed")
        forms = [identity_form(p) for p in variants]
        if len(set(forms)) != len(forms) or any(p["uniqueid"] != uid or p["pid"] != first["pid"] for p in variants):
            raise Invalid("duplicate/inconsistent full metadata variants")
        imap[uid] = e
        by_uid[uid], unknown_refs[uid] = [], []
    introduced = {uid: set() for uid in imap}
    for index, row in enumerate(events, 1):
        if not isinstance(row, list) or len(row) != 6:
            raise Invalid("identity event row schema")
        uid, variant, status, begin, end, unproved = row
        if not integer(uid, 1) or uid not in imap or not integer(variant, 0) or \
                variant >= len(imap[uid]["variants"]) or not integer(status, 0) or \
                not finite(begin) or not finite(end) or not start <= begin <= end <= cutoff or \
                not isinstance(unproved, bool):
            raise Invalid("unbound identity event or impossible actual acquisition interval")
        if variant not in introduced[uid]:
            if variant != len(introduced[uid]) or imap[uid]["variants"][variant]["status"] != status:
                raise Invalid("variant lacks its actual first acquisition")
            introduced[uid].add(variant)
        by_uid[uid].append(index)
        if unproved:
            unknown_refs[uid].append(index)
    decoded = {}
    def event_at(ref):
        if not integer(ref, 1) or ref > len(events):
            raise Invalid("missing completed native identity reference")
        if ref not in decoded:
            uid, variant, status, begin, end, unknown = events[ref - 1]
            p = imap[uid]["variants"][variant]
            p = p if p["status"] == status else dict(p, status=status)
            decoded[ref] = {"identity": p, "mono_begin": begin, "mono_end": end, "unproved": unknown}
        return decoded[ref]
    def first_last(e, refs):
        if not refs:
            raise Invalid("identity history has no completed native event")
        first_ref = min(refs, key=lambda r: (events[r - 1][4], r))
        last_ref = max(refs, key=lambda r: (events[r - 1][4], r))
        first, last = event_at(first_ref), event_at(last_ref)
        if not integer(e.get("first_event_ref"), 1) or not integer(e.get("last_event_ref"), 1) or \
                e["first_event_ref"] != first_ref or e["last_event_ref"] != last_ref or \
                not same(e.get("first_identity"), first["identity"]) or not same(e.get("last_identity"), last["identity"]) or \
                e.get("mono_first_begin") != first["mono_begin"] or e.get("mono_first_seen") != first["mono_end"] or \
                e.get("mono_last_begin") != last["mono_begin"] or e.get("mono_last_seen") != last["mono_end"]:
            raise Invalid("count/first/last/identity interval not reconstructible from actual events")
    for uid, e in imap.items():
        if e["observations"] != len(by_uid[uid]) or introduced[uid] != set(range(len(e["variants"]))):
            raise Invalid("unsupported observation scalar or unused variant")
        first_last(e, by_uid[uid])
    def retained(p, interval=None, ref=None):
        identity(p)
        uid = p["uniqueid"]
        refs = by_uid.get(uid, [])
        if ref is not None:
            refs = [ref]
        matches = [event_at(r) for r in refs if same(event_at(r)["identity"], p)]
        if interval is not None:
            begin, end = interval
            matches = [e for e in matches if begin <= e["mono_begin"] <= e["mono_end"] <= end]
        if not matches:
            raise Invalid("full identity not joined to a compatible completed native interval")
    umap = {}
    for e in uh:
        p = e.get("first_identity")
        identity(p)
        uid = p["uniqueid"]
        if uid in umap or uid in baseuids or uid not in imap or not unknown_refs[uid]:
            raise Invalid("unproved first evidence missing/duplicated/exempted")
        first_last(e, unknown_refs[uid])
        umap[uid] = e
    if {uid for uid, refs in unknown_refs.items() if refs} != set(umap):
        raise Invalid("a completed unproved acquisition disappeared from history")
    prior = None
    for e in ch:
        row = e.get("observation")
        if not finite(e.get("mono")) or (prior is not None and e["mono"] < prior) or not isinstance(row, list) or \
                len(row) != 3 or not integer(row[0], 1) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in row[1:]):
            raise Invalid("coverage evidence malformed/reordered")
        prior = e["mono"]
    attempt_by_end = {}
    for e in ats:
        if e.get("kind") not in ("identity_scan", "resource_scan") or e.get("phase") not in ("ADMISSION", "PRE_GO", "RUNNING", "FINAL") or \
                not isinstance(e.get("inside_helper"), bool) or not isinstance(e.get("aborted"), bool) or \
                not finite(e.get("mono_start")) or not finite(e.get("mono_end")) or e["mono_end"] < e["mono_start"] or \
                (e["aborted"] and not isinstance(e.get("error"), str)) or (not e["aborted"] and e.get("error") is not None):
            raise Invalid("completed/aborted attempt missing")
        if e["kind"] == "resource_scan":
            if e["mono_end"] in attempt_by_end:
                raise Invalid("duplicate resource attempt")
            attempt_by_end[e["mono_end"]] = e
    prior_start = None
    for c in cs:
        a = attempt_by_end.pop(c.get("mono_end"), None)
        if a is None or not finite(c.get("mono_start")) or a["mono_start"] < c["mono_start"] or \
                (prior_start is not None and c["mono_start"] <= prior_start) or c.get("phase") != a["phase"] or \
                c.get("inside_helper") != a["inside_helper"] or c.get("aborted") != a["aborted"] or \
                not isinstance(c.get("complete"), bool) or not integer(c.get("incomplete_n"), 0) or \
                not isinstance(c.get("incomplete"), list) or len(c["incomplete"]) != min(c["incomplete_n"], 30):
            raise Invalid("resource observation/attempt binding invalid")
        prior_start = c["mono_start"]
        if c["aborted"]:
            if c["complete"] is not False or c.get("mono_complete") is not None or not finite(c.get("mono_aborted")) or \
                    not c["mono_start"] <= c["mono_aborted"] <= c["mono_end"] or c.get("abort_error") != a["error"]:
                raise Invalid("aborted observation presented as complete")
        elif not finite(c.get("mono_complete")) or not c["mono_start"] <= c["mono_complete"] <= c["mono_end"] or \
                c["complete"] != (c["incomplete_n"] == 0):
            raise Invalid("completed resource observation missing")
        if not all(integer(c.get(k), 0) for k in ("pids", "lane_busy", "lane_rss")) or c["lane_busy"] > 2 or \
                not all(isinstance(c.get(k), list) for k in
                    ("owned_live", "unproved_live", "owned_event_refs", "unproved_event_refs",
                     "group_live", "owned_zombies", "lane_pids", "lane_busy_pids", "measurements")):
            raise Invalid("resource/history hard policy or schema")
        if not same(c.get("raw_measurements", []), []):
            raise Invalid("pending/nullable native resource composite cannot qualify an original22 control")
        for row in c["incomplete"]:
            if not any(same(e["observation"], row) and c["mono_start"] <= e["mono"] <= c["mono_end"] for e in ch):
                raise Invalid("missing-read coverage omitted")
        for label in ("owned", "unproved"):
            if len(c[label + "_live"]) != len(c[label + "_event_refs"]):
                raise Invalid("current identity/ref arrays disagree")
            for p, ref in zip(c[label + "_live"], c[label + "_event_refs"]):
                if not integer(ref, 1):
                    raise Invalid("completed census acquisition ref absent")
                retained(p, (c["mono_start"], c["mono_end"]), ref)
                if label == "unproved" and p["uniqueid"] not in umap:
                    raise Invalid("current unproved incarnation missing historical evidence")
        measurements, mpids, bpids, total, last = c["measurements"], [], [], 0, None
        for m in measurements:
            expected_measurement = {"identity", "identity_event_ref", "before_task_event_ref", "identity_after",
                "identity_after_event_ref", "identity_after_interval", "mono_task_begin", "mono_task_end",
                "rss", "cpu_ticks", "busy", "mono_observed", "bracket_verified", "epoch_observed"}
            if not isinstance(m, dict) or set(m) != expected_measurement or m["bracket_verified"] is not True or \
                    not finite(m["epoch_observed"]):
                raise Invalid("complete verified native task composite/schema/epoch unavailable")
            p, after = m.get("identity"), m.get("identity_after")
            retained(p, (c["mono_start"], c["mono_end"]), m.get("identity_event_ref"))
            retained(after, (c["mono_start"], c["mono_end"]), m.get("identity_after_event_ref"))
            before_event = event_at(m.get("before_task_event_ref"))
            after_event = event_at(m.get("identity_after_event_ref"))
            if identity(before_event["identity"]) != identity(p) or identity(after) != identity(p) or \
                    not same(m.get("identity_after_interval"), [after_event["mono_begin"], after_event["mono_end"]]) or \
                    not all(finite(m.get(k)) for k in ("mono_task_begin", "mono_task_end", "mono_observed")) or \
                    not before_event["mono_end"] <= m["mono_task_begin"] <= m["mono_task_end"] <= after_event["mono_begin"] <= after_event["mono_end"] <= m["mono_observed"]:
                raise Invalid("actual task/identity brackets do not causally enclose the measurement")
            if not integer(m.get("rss"), 0) or not integer(m.get("cpu_ticks"), 0) or not isinstance(m.get("busy"), bool) or \
                    not c["mono_start"] <= m["mono_observed"] <= c["mono_end"] or \
                    (last is not None and m["mono_observed"] <= last) or p["pid"] in mpids:
                raise Invalid("bracketed PID-specific measurement missing")
            mpids.append(p["pid"])
            total += m["rss"]
            if m["busy"]:
                bpids.append(p["pid"])
            last = m["mono_observed"]
        if c["lane_rss"] != total or sorted(c["lane_pids"]) != sorted(mpids) or \
                sorted(c["lane_busy_pids"]) != sorted(bpids) or c["lane_busy"] != len(bpids) or \
                (last is not None and c.get("mono_last_observation") != last):
            raise Invalid("partial counters disagree with completed measurements")
    if attempt_by_end:
        raise Invalid("resource attempt omitted from history")
    return imap, umap, retained, event_at


def history_extensions(old, new):
    for key in ("coverage_history", "census_observations", "observation_attempts", "identity_events", "accounting_observations"):
        a, b = old[key], new[key]
        if len(b) < len(a) or not same(b[:len(a)], a):
            raise Invalid("postpublication history prefix changed: " + key)
    if any(row[3] < old["mono_decision"] for row in new["identity_events"][len(old["identity_events"]):]):
        raise Invalid("new current acquisition falsely predates frozen producer decision")
    for key in ("identity_history", "unproved_history"):
        before = {e["first_identity"]["uniqueid"]: e for e in old[key]}
        after = {e["first_identity"]["uniqueid"]: e for e in new[key]}
        if not set(before) <= set(after):
            raise Invalid("historical incarnation vanished")
        for uid, first in before.items():
            last = after[uid]
            for k in ("first_identity", "mono_first_begin", "mono_first_seen", "first_event_ref"):
                if not same(first[k], last[k]):
                    raise Invalid("immutable first actual acquisition changed")
            if last["mono_last_seen"] < first["mono_last_seen"]:
                raise Invalid("last physical observation rewound")
            advanced = any(not same(first[k], last[k]) for k in
                           ("last_identity", "mono_last_begin", "mono_last_seen", "last_event_ref"))
            if last["last_event_ref"] == first["last_event_ref"] and advanced:
                raise Invalid("same event reference claims changed native acquisition")
            if key == "identity_history":
                if last["source"] != first["source"] or last["observations"] < first["observations"] or \
                        not same(last["variants"][:len(first["variants"])], first["variants"]) or \
                        ((advanced or not same(last["variants"], first["variants"])) and last["observations"] <= first["observations"]):
                    raise Invalid("history advances without additional actual acquisition references")
    if new["history_charge_bytes"] < old["history_charge_bytes"]:
        raise Invalid("history accounting rewound")


def census_join(c, observations, subset=False):
    if not isinstance(c, dict):
        raise Invalid("embedded census missing")
    matches = [r for r in observations if (all(k in r and same(v, r[k]) for k, v in c.items()) if subset else same(c, r))]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise Invalid("embedded census does not join a unique retained observation")
    return matches[0]


def main_stream_evidence(receipt, summary, cfg, files, samples):
    if receipt["child_pid"] is None:
        if not same(receipt.get("streams"), {}) or not same(summary["reconciliation"].get("streams"), {}):
            raise Invalid("admission-negative MAIN stream map is not empty")
