        if len(targets) != 1 or targets[0]["pid"] != report.get("grandchild"):
            raise Invalid("full intended descendant incarnation missing")
        target = targets[0]
        final = receipt["final_census"]
        blockers = final["owned_live"] + final["unproved_live"]
        if len(blockers) != 1 or not compatible(blockers[0], target, (final["mono_begin"], final["mono_end"])) or \
                blockers[0]["status"] == 5 or not in_ledger(blockers[0], True):
            raise Invalid("intended full incarnation is not the sole retained live blocker")
        uid, classification = blockers[0]["uniqueid"], report.get("required_ownership_class")
        if name in ("ownership_group", "ownership_slow"):
            owned = registry.get(uid)
            if owned is None or owned["root"] != main["uniqueid"] or not in_ledger(target, True) or \
                    final["unproved_live"] != [] or len(final["owned_live"]) != 1:
                raise Invalid("group/slow requires known ownership, never an unproved alternative")
            if name == "ownership_group" and (classification != "known_group" or owned["via"] != "owned_group" or
                    owned["identity"]["pgid"] != main["pgid"]):
                raise Invalid("known same-group root proof missing")
            if name == "ownership_slow" and (classification != "known_current_parent" or
                    owned["via"] != "current_parent:%d" % main["uniqueid"] or owned["identity"]["ppid"] != main["pid"]):
                raise Invalid("slow control lacks observed current-parent ownership")
        elif classification != "known_or_unproved" or not in_ledger(target) or \
                (uid not in registry and uid not in {e["first_identity"]["uniqueid"] for e in receipt["unproved_history"]}):
            raise Invalid("fast/double permitted branch not retained as known or unproved")
        require("intended_full_descendant_and_exact_ownership_root", True)
    if name == "zombie_hold":
        targets = selected("zombie", "zombie_hold_start")
        if len(targets) != 1:
            raise Invalid("actual held-zombie incarnation missing")
        z = targets[0]
        if z["status"] != 5 or z["pid"] != report.get("grandchild") or z["uniqueid"] not in extra or \
                extra[z["uniqueid"]]["root"] != main["uniqueid"] or not in_ledger(z, True) or not any(
                    z["pid"] in c["owned_zombies"] and any(identity(p) == identity(z) and p["status"] == 5 for p in c["owned_live"])
                    for c in receipt["census_observations"]) or not any(j["pid"] == z["pid"] for j in report["joins"]):
            raise Invalid("reported full zombie/parent-root/wait evidence not observed and retained")
        require("intended_full_zombie_retained_and_reaped", True)
    if name == "busy2":
        targets = selected("busy_spinner", "pre_spin")
        if len(targets) != 1 or not in_ledger(targets[0], True):
            raise Invalid("intended pre-spin full descendant not retained")
        kid = targets[0]
        if kid["uniqueid"] not in extra or extra[kid["uniqueid"]]["root"] != main["uniqueid"] or \
                extra[kid["uniqueid"]]["via"] != "owned_group" or kid["pgid"] != main["pgid"] or \
                report.get("busy_pids") != [main["pid"], kid["pid"]] or \
                report.get("busy_gate") != "not_released_before_identity_and_IDS" or cfg["cpu_slots"] != 2:
            raise Invalid("two-slot intended busy ownership/gate proof missing")
        trip = receipt["trips"][0]
        d = trip.get("detail")
        if not isinstance(d, dict) or d.get("count") != 2 or set(d.get("pids", [])) != {main["pid"], kid["pid"]}:
            raise Invalid("BUSY cause not the exact two intended PIDs")
        pair = {identity(main), identity(kid)}
        witnessed = False
        for c in receipt["census_observations"]:
            busy = [m for m in c["measurements"] if m["busy"]]
            if {identity(m["identity"]) for m in busy} == pair and len(busy) == 2 and \
                    max(m["mono_observed"] for m in busy) <= trip["mono"] <= c["mono_end"]:
                witnessed = True
        require("two_full_intended_busy_measurements_cause_first_excess", witnessed)
    if name == "rss":
        if report.get("rss_pid") != main["pid"] or report.get("allocated") != 320 * 1024 * 1024 or \
                report.get("touched_bytes") != report["allocated"] or report.get("touch_stride") != 4096 or \
                report.get("touch_writes") != 81920 or report.get("touch_write_bytes") != 81920 or \
                not integer(report.get("page_size"), 1) or report.get("term_masked_for_evidence") is not True:
            raise Invalid("actual bounded intended RSS allocation/touch evidence missing")
        for key in ("rss_before", "rss_after"):
            r = report.get(key)
            if not isinstance(r, dict) or set(r) != {"pid", "identity_before", "identity_after", "rss_bytes", "mono_start", "mono_end", "error"} or \
                    not integer(r.get("pid"), 1) or r["pid"] != main["pid"] or r["error"] is not None or \
                    not integer(r["rss_bytes"], 0) or not finite(r["mono_start"]) or not finite(r["mono_end"]):
                raise Invalid("PID-specific child RSS bracket missing")
            before, after = r["identity_before"], r["identity_after"]
            a = child_observation(before, report["mono_life_deadline"], {main["pid"]})
            b = child_observation(after, report["mono_life_deadline"], {main["pid"]})
            if a is None or b is None or identity(a) != identity(b) or identity(a) != identity(main) or \
                    before["observer"] != main["pid"] or after["observer"] != main["pid"] or \
                    before["role"] != "main" or after["role"] != "main" or \
                    before["phase"] != "rss_measurement_before" or after["phase"] != "rss_measurement_after" or \
                    not before["observed_mono"] <= r["mono_start"] <= after["mono_start"] <= \
                        after["observed_mono"] <= r["mono_end"] <= report["mono_output"]:
                raise Invalid("RSS task read lacks intended full fingerprint/native bracket/report chronology")
        if not all(integer(report.get(k), 0) for k in ("rss_before_bytes", "rss_after_bytes", "rss_delta_bytes")) or \
                report["rss_before_bytes"] != report["rss_before"]["rss_bytes"] or \
                report["rss_after_bytes"] != report["rss_after"]["rss_bytes"] or \
                report["rss_delta_bytes"] != report["rss_after_bytes"] - report["rss_before_bytes"] or \
                not all(finite(report.get(k)) for k in ("mono_before_allocation", "mono_after_touch")) or \
                not report["rss_before"]["mono_end"] <= report["mono_before_allocation"] <= \
                    report["rss_after"]["identity_before"]["mono_start"] <= report["rss_after"]["mono_end"] <= \
                    report["mono_after_touch"] <= report["mono_output"] or report["rss_after_bytes"] <= cfg["rss_trip_bytes"]:
            raise Invalid("RSS reported counters contradict actual bracketed task records")
        trip, witnessed = receipt["trips"][0], False
        for c in receipt["census_observations"]:
            partial = 0
            for index, m in enumerate(c["measurements"]):
                partial += m["rss"]
                following = c["measurements"][index + 1]["mono_observed"] if index + 1 < len(c["measurements"]) else c["mono_end"]
                if identity(m["identity"]) == identity(main) and m["rss"] > cfg["rss_trip_bytes"] and \
                        partial == trip.get("detail") and m["mono_observed"] <= trip["mono"] <= following:
                    witnessed = True
        require("intended_PID_alone_exceeds_RSS_and_is_in_exact_first_trip_prefix", witnessed)
    if name in ("mutate_pin", "mutate_evidence"):
        creation = report.get("creation")
        manifest = receipt["go_creation_manifest"]
        path = cfg["creation_channel"]["target_path"]
        actual = files["launch.json"] if name == "mutate_evidence" else absolute_snapshot(path, 1 << 20)
        raw_original = actual["raw"][:-1]
        original = {"path": path, "inode": actual["inode"], "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw_original).hexdigest(),
                    "bytes": len(raw_original), "nlink": 1}
        after = {"path": path, **hash_entry(actual)}
        expected_manifest = {"kind": "qualification-creation-manifest-v1", "scenario": name,
                             "preparation_sha256": preparation["sha256"], "run": prep["run"],
                             "output_root": prep["output_root"], "target": original}
        manifest_line = (json.dumps(expected_manifest, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
        if not same(manifest, expected_manifest) or len(manifest_line) > 4096:
            raise Invalid("creation manifest semantic schema/original publication binding")
        if not isinstance(creation, dict) or not same(creation.get("manifest"), manifest) or \
                creation.get("manifest_sha256") != receipt["go_creation_manifest_sha256"] or \
                creation.get("manifest_line_bytes") != len(manifest_line) or \
                creation.get("preparation_sha256") != preparation["sha256"] or \
                not same(creation.get("run"), prep["run"]) or not same(creation.get("output_root"), prep["output_root"]) or \
                not same(creation.get("original"), original) or not same(creation.get("after"), after) or \
                not same(manifest.get("target"), original) or not same(manifest.get("run"), prep["run"]) or \
                not same(manifest.get("output_root"), prep["output_root"]) or \
                manifest.get("preparation_sha256") != preparation["sha256"] or \
                not same(creation.get("preparation_facts"), {"path": QROOT + "/" + name + "/preparation.json", **hash_entry(preparation)}) or \
                creation.get("name_inode_before") != original["inode"] or creation.get("name_inode_after") != original["inode"] or \
                creation.get("append_bytes") != 1 or actual["raw"] != raw_original + b"x" or \
                not all(finite(creation.get(k)) for k in ("mono_verified", "mono_append", "mono_fsync_completed", "mono_after_verified")) or \
                not creation["mono_verified"] <= creation["mono_append"] <= creation["mono_fsync_completed"] <= creation["mono_after_verified"] < report["mono_life_deadline"]:
            raise Invalid("original approved creation identity not continuously verified BEFORE mutation")
        if name == "mutate_pin" and (not same(original, prep["fixture"]) or raw_original != FIXTURE):
            raise Invalid("mutated inode not original CREATED approved fresh fixture")
        if name == "mutate_evidence" and original["sha256"] != receipt["launch_record_sha256"]:
            raise Invalid("launch mutation not bound to original publication digest/inode")
        require("approved_original_creation_inode_and_before_append_checks", True)
    return reported


def verify(name, approval_digest, actual_exit, runfd, outfd):
    exp, C = expectations(name), {}
    result = {"checker": VERSION, "scenario": name, "criteria": C,
              "parent_release": "not granted; separate ended-owned and late-artifact disposition mandatory"}
    def require(key, ok):
        C[key] = bool(ok)
    ap = snapshot(runfd, "parent-authorization.json", 1 << 20)
    if ap["sha256"] != approval_digest:
        raise Invalid("approval digest differs from the parent-supplied trusted digest")
    approval = decode(ap["raw"])
    if not isinstance(approval, dict) or approval.get("kind") != "v19-qualification-invocation-v1" or approval.get("scenario") != name:
        raise Invalid("approval kind/scenario")
    cp, gp, sp, pp = (snapshot(runfd, f, 1 << 20) for f in ("config.json", "go.json", "stability.json", "preparation.json"))
    require("approval_artifact_bindings", all(approval.get(k) == v["sha256"] for k, v in (
        ("config_sha256", cp), ("go_sha256", gp), ("stability_receipt_sha256", sp), ("preparation_sha256", pp))))
    package = approval.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(package, dict) or set(package) != {"supervisor", "child", "writer", "checker"}:
        raise Invalid("approval must pin the entire four-source package")
    expected_sources = {"supervisor": (SUPERVISOR, SUPERVISOR_SHA), "child": (CHILD, None),
                        "writer": (WRITER, None), "checker": (CHECKER, None)}
    source_ok = True
    for key, (path, h) in expected_sources.items():
        src = absolute_snapshot(path, 1 << 20)
        pinned = package[key]
        source_ok = source_ok and isinstance(pinned, dict) and set(pinned) == {"path", "sha256"} and \
            pinned["path"] == path and pinned["sha256"] == src["sha256"] and (h is None or h == src["sha256"])
    require("approved_sources_match_actual_bytes", source_ok)
    py = approval.get("python")
    if not isinstance(py, dict) or not isinstance(py.get("path"), str) or not py["path"].endswith("/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python") or os.path.realpath(py["path"]) != py["path"]:
        raise Invalid("approval interpreter must be the actual Python.app executable, not its launcher")
    require("actual_interpreter_digest", absolute_snapshot(py["path"])["sha256"] == py.get("sha256"))
    cfg, go, stability, prep = (decode(p["raw"]) for p in (cp, gp, sp, pp))
    adm = cfg["admission"]
    channel = {} if name not in ("mutate_pin", "mutate_evidence") else {
        "kind": "qualification-creation-v1", "scenario": name,
        "preparation_path": QROOT + "/" + name + "/preparation.json", "preparation_sha256": pp["sha256"],
        "target_path": QROOT + "/" + name + ("/pinned-scratch.txt" if name == "mutate_pin" else "/out/launch.json")}
    expected_cfg = config_for(name, py["path"], py["sha256"], adm["outstanding_reservations_bytes"],
                              adm["lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes"], package, pp["sha256"], channel)
    require("exact_scenario_config", same(cfg, expected_cfg))
    reservation = {"bytes": RESERVATION, "cpu_slots": cfg["cpu_slots"],
                   "outstanding_reservations_bytes": adm["outstanding_reservations_bytes"],
                   "lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes": adm["lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes"]}
    require("current_parent_allocation", same(approval.get("allocation"), reservation) and
            all(integer(adm[k], 0) for k in ("outstanding_reservations_bytes", "lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes")))
    expected_prep = {"kind": "qualification-creation-preparation-v1", "scenario": name,
                     "run": {"path": QROOT + "/" + name, "inode": [os.fstat(runfd).st_dev, os.fstat(runfd).st_ino]},
                     "output_root": {"path": QROOT + "/" + name + "/out", "inode": [os.fstat(outfd).st_dev, os.fstat(outfd).st_ino]},
                     "fixture": None, "source_pins": package, "python": py, "allocation": reservation,
                     "negative_control": name not in ("ok", "rc_nonzero")}
    if name == "mutate_pin":
        original = prep.get("fixture") if isinstance(prep, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(original, dict) or not isinstance(original.get("inode"), list) or len(original["inode"]) != 2 or \
                not all(integer(v, 0) for v in original["inode"]):
            raise Invalid("original CREATED fixture descriptor identity missing")
        expected_prep["fixture"] = {"path": QROOT + "/" + name + "/pinned-scratch.txt", "inode": original["inode"],
                                    "bytes": len(FIXTURE), "nlink": 1, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(FIXTURE).hexdigest()}
        require("created_fixture_original_identity_retained", snapshot(runfd, "pinned-scratch.txt", 1 << 20)["inode"] == original["inode"])
    require("preparation_complete_semantics_and_approved_creation", same(prep, expected_prep))
    negative = None
    if name in NEGATIVE_PROCESS:
        negative = {"scenario": name, "kind": "ownership", "creation_channel": False}
        require("all_forking_negative_approval", approval.get("ownership_negative") is True)
    elif name in ("mutate_pin", "mutate_evidence"):
        negative = {"scenario": name, "kind": "mutation", "creation_channel": True}
        require("mutation_negative_approval", approval.get("mutation_negative") is True)
    elif name in ("date_fault", "helper_overrun", "helper_group", "helper_eof"):
        negative = {"scenario": name, "kind": "helper_injection", "creation_channel": False}
        require("helper_injection_approval", approval.get("helper_injection") is True)
    require("exact_individual_negative_GO", same(go.get("qualification_negative"), negative))
    expected_entry = {k: cfg[k] for k in ("output_roots", "argv", "max_wall_s", "cpu_slots", "creation_channel")}
    expected_entry.update({k: adm[k] for k in ("reservation_bytes", "outstanding_reservations_bytes", "lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes")})
    require("go_envelope", go.get("decision") == "GO" and go.get("item") == ITEM and finite(go.get("not_after_epoch")) and
            go.get("stability_receipt_sha256") == sp["sha256"] and stability.get("verdict") == "PASS")
    require("go_exact_listing", isinstance(go.get("configs"), dict) and
            same(go["configs"], {} if name == "go_unlisted" else {cp["sha256"]: expected_entry}))
    expected_root = {"kind": "v19-qualification-root", "package": "v9", "qroot": QROOT, "source_pins": package}
    qfd = directory(QROOT)
    try:
        require("fresh_package_root_marker", same(decode(snapshot(qfd, "package-root.json", 1 << 20)["raw"]), expected_root))
    finally:
        os.close(qfd)
    files = {n: snapshot(outfd, n, optional=True) for n in ("supervisor-receipt.json", "settlement.json",
              "settlement.json.staged", "launch.json", "samples.jsonl", "stdout.txt", "stderr.txt", "child-out.json", "stray.txt")}
    if any(files[n] is None for n in ("supervisor-receipt.json", "settlement.json", "settlement.json.staged")):
        raise Invalid("missing receipt or settlement publication")
    receipt = decode(files["supervisor-receipt.json"]["raw"])
    settlement = decode(files["settlement.json"]["raw"])
    summaries = sequence(snapshot(runfd, "supervisor-summary.txt", 16 << 20)["raw"])
    if len(summaries) != 1:
        raise Invalid("exactly one captured supervisor summary required")
    summary = summaries[0]
    require("complete_parent_stderr_capture", snapshot(runfd, "supervisor-stderr.txt", 16 << 20)["raw"] == b"")
    common_summary_keys = {"supervisor", "acknowledged", "exit_code", "receipt_sha256", "settlement_record_sha256",
                           "post_publish_mono", "publication_resources", "ack_resources", "publication_payload_bytes", "reconciliation"}
    expected_summary_keys = common_summary_keys | ({"reason", "clock_note", "error", "error_code"} if
        name in ("go_unlisted", "date_fault", "helper_overrun", "helper_group", "helper_eof") else
        {"settlement", "config_sha256", "receipt_bytes", "settlement_bytes", "ack_commit", "child_returncode", "failure_codes",
         "owned_live", "unproved_live", "ack_census", "contract_violations", "unproved_history", "coverage_history", "census_observations"})
    require("exact_summary_schema_no_hidden_contradictory_outcomes", set(summary) == expected_summary_keys and
            summary.get("supervisor") == "owned_supervisor_v19")
    rsha, ssha = files["supervisor-receipt.json"]["sha256"], files["settlement.json"]["sha256"]
    require("receipt_source_config_binding", receipt.get("supervisor") == "owned_supervisor_v19" and
            receipt.get("supervisor_sha256") == SUPERVISOR_SHA and receipt.get("config_sha256") == cp["sha256"])
    require("settlement_receipt_binding", settlement.get("receipt_sha256") == rsha and settlement.get("receipt") == cfg["receipt"] and
            settlement.get("config_sha256") == cp["sha256"] and settlement.get("supervisor") == "owned_supervisor_v19")
    a, b = files["settlement.json"], files["settlement.json.staged"]
    require("same_inode_staged_link", a["sha256"] == b["sha256"] and a["inode"] == b["inode"] and a["nlink"] == b["nlink"] == 2)
    require("summary_and_actual_exit", integer(actual_exit) and integer(summary.get("exit_code")) and
            actual_exit == exp["exit"] == summary["exit_code"] and
            summary.get("receipt_sha256") == rsha and summary.get("settlement_record_sha256") == ssha)
    if name in ("go_unlisted", "date_fault", "helper_overrun", "helper_group", "helper_eof"):
        require("intended_ack_refusal", summary.get("acknowledged") is False and summary.get("reason") == "ACK_REFUSED")
    else:
        require("publication_acknowledged", summary.get("acknowledged") is True and summary.get("settlement") == exp["state"] and
                summary.get("config_sha256") == cp["sha256"] and summary.get("receipt_bytes") == files["supervisor-receipt.json"]["bytes"] and
                summary.get("settlement_bytes") == files["settlement.json"]["bytes"] and finite(summary.get("post_publish_mono")))
    failures, trips = receipt.get("failures"), receipt.get("trips")
    if not isinstance(failures, list) or not all(isinstance(f, dict) and isinstance(f.get("code"), str) and finite(f.get("mono")) for f in failures):
        raise Invalid("malformed failure entries")
    if not isinstance(trips, list) or not all(isinstance(t, dict) and isinstance(t.get("trip"), str) and finite(t.get("mono")) and finite(t.get("epoch")) for t in trips):
        raise Invalid("malformed trip entries")
    codes, tripcodes = [f["code"] for f in failures], [t["trip"] for t in trips]
    if exp.get("derive_exact_blocker_code"):
        fc_early = receipt.get("final_census") or {}
        if fc_early.get("owned_live"):
            exp["failures"].add("OWNED_LIVE")
        if fc_early.get("unproved_live"):
            exp["failures"].add("UNPROVED_LIVE")
    require("failure_sets_exact", len(codes) == len(set(codes)) and set(codes) == exp["failures"] and settlement.get("failure_codes") == sorted(codes))
    require("trip_sets_exact", tripcodes == exp["trips"] == settlement.get("trips"))
    rc = receipt.get("child_returncode")
    require("state_rc_loop_exact", receipt.get("settlement") == settlement.get("settlement") == exp["state"] and
            same(rc, exp["rc"]) and (rc is None or integer(rc)) and same(settlement.get("child_returncode"), rc) and
            receipt.get("loop_status") == exp["loop"])
    require("mandatory_owned_date_helpers", helper_evidence(receipt, cfg, name))
    require("no_hidden_cancellation_or_lost_wait", receipt.get("cancel") == {"signal": None, "mono": None} and
            receipt.get("wait_status_lost") is False)
    expected_pin_end = [[p["path"], not (name == "mutate_pin" and p["path"].endswith("/pinned-scratch.txt"))] for p in cfg["pins"]]
    require("pin_end_results_exact", receipt.get("pins_at_end") == expected_pin_end)
    sig, stop = receipt.get("signal"), receipt.get("stop_request")
    if exp["signal"] is None:
        require("signal_exact", sig is None and stop is None)
    elif exp["signal"] == "sent":
        require("signal_exact", isinstance(sig, dict) and sig.get("sent") is True and sig.get("identity_ok") is True and finite(sig.get("mono_sent")))
    elif exp["signal"] == "reaped":
        require("signal_exact", isinstance(sig, dict) and sig.get("sent") is False and sig.get("why_not") == "CHILD_ALREADY_REAPED" and stop.get("reason") == "FAILURE")
    else:

def main():
    if os.path.abspath(__file__) != CHECKER or os.path.realpath(__file__) != CHECKER:
        raise Invalid("checker must execute at the exact approved fixed source path")
    if len(sys.argv) != 4 or sys.argv[1] not in SC:
        raise Invalid("usage: SCENARIO PARENT_APPROVAL_SHA256 ACTUAL_EXIT")
    name, approval_digest, exit_text = sys.argv[1:4]
    if len(approval_digest) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in approval_digest):
        raise Invalid("parent approval digest format")
    actual_exit = int(exit_text)
    runfd = directory(QROOT + "/" + name)
    outfd = os.open("out", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=runfd)
    try:
        try:
            result = verify(name, approval_digest, actual_exit, runfd, outfd)
        except (Invalid, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError, IndexError, UnicodeDecodeError, OverflowError, RecursionError) as e:
            result = {"checker": VERSION, "scenario": name, "verdict": "FAIL", "criteria": {}, "error": repr(e)}
        data = (json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=1, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
        fd = os.open("check.json", os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o644, dir_fd=runfd)
        try:
            view = memoryview(data)
            while view:
                n = os.write(fd, view)
                if n <= 0:
                    raise Invalid("zero-progress checker write")
                view = view[n:]
            os.fsync(fd)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        os.fsync(runfd)
        print(json.dumps({"scenario": name, "verdict": result["verdict"], "failed": [k for k, v in result["criteria"].items() if not v]}))
        return 0 if result["verdict"] == "PASS" else 1
    finally:
        os.close(outfd)
        os.close(runfd)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write("CHECKER_ERROR %r\n" % e)
        sys.exit(2)

class Invalid(Exception):
    pass


class ModelBoundary(Exception):

class ModelClockUnavailable(Exception):

def canonical(obj):
    return (json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()


def pairs(items):
    out = {}
    for key, value in items:
        if key in out:
            raise Invalid("duplicate JSON key")
        out[key] = value
    return out


def decode(raw):
    def floating(text):
        value = float(text)
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            raise Invalid("nonfinite number")
        return value
    def constant(text):
        raise Invalid("nonfinite constant")
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                      parse_float=floating, parse_constant=constant)


def integer(value, minimum=0):
    return type(value) is int and value >= minimum


def finite(value):
    return type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value)


def hex64(value):
    return type(value) is str and len(value) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value)


def same(left, right):
    return canonical(left) == canonical(right)


def directory(path):
    if not path.startswith("/") or os.path.normpath(path) != path:
        raise Invalid("noncanonical directory")
    fd = os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        for part in path.lstrip("/").split("/"):
            if part in ("", ".", ".."):
                raise Invalid("directory component")
            nxt = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
            os.close(fd)
            fd = nxt
        return fd
    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)
        raise


class NativeBudget:
    def __init__(self, begin):
        self.begin = begin
        self.max_rss = 0
        self.checks = 0

    def check(self):
        now = time.monotonic()
        rss = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
        # Darwin ru_maxrss is bytes. This fixture refuses other platforms.
        self.max_rss = max(self.max_rss, rss)
        self.checks += 1
        if now - self.begin > 280.0 or rss > RSS_LIMIT:
            raise BudgetStop("native cooperative budget exhausted")
        return now


def signature(s):
    return (s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_mode, s.st_size, s.st_nlink, s.st_mtime_ns, s.st_ctime_ns)


def snapshot(fdroot, name, budget, cap=MAX_BYTES):
    budget.check()
    before = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fdroot, follow_symlinks=False)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or not 0 <= before.st_size <= cap or before.st_nlink != 1:
        raise Invalid("not a bounded one-link regular file")
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=fdroot)
    try:
        if signature(os.fstat(fd)) != signature(before):
            raise Invalid("changed open")
        data = bytearray()
        while len(data) < before.st_size:
            budget.check()
            part = os.read(fd, min(65536, before.st_size - len(data)))
            if not part:
                raise Invalid("short read")
            data.extend(part)
        if os.read(fd, 1) or signature(os.fstat(fd)) != signature(before) or \
                signature(os.stat(name, dir_fd=fdroot, follow_symlinks=False)) != signature(before):
            raise Invalid("changed read")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    budget.check()
    raw = bytes(data)
    return {"raw": raw, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(raw),
            "inode": [before.st_dev, before.st_ino], "nlink": before.st_nlink,
            "mode": stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode)}


def absolute_snapshot(path, budget):
    fd = directory(os.path.dirname(path))
    try:
        return snapshot(fd, os.path.basename(path), budget)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def facts(entry):
    return {k: entry[k] for k in ("sha256", "bytes", "inode", "nlink", "mode")}


def authority(case, digest, runfd, budget):
    approval = snapshot(runfd, "parent-authorization.json", budget, 1 << 20)
    request = snapshot(runfd, "request.json", budget, 1 << 20)
    if approval["sha256"] != digest:
        raise Invalid("external parent SHA mismatch")
    ap, rq = decode(approval["raw"]), decode(request["raw"])
    run = {"path": ROOT + "/" + case, "inode": [os.fstat(runfd).st_dev, os.fstat(runfd).st_ino]}
    request_keys = {"kind", "case", "scope", "run", "hook_set", "negative_control", "allocation",
                    "not_after_epoch", "model_inputs_sha256"}
    approval_keys = {"kind", "case", "scope", "request_sha256", "run", "sources", "hook_set",
                     "negative_control", "allocation", "not_after_epoch", "authority", "ownership_negative",
                     "mutation_negative", "native_config"}
    if type(rq) is not dict or set(rq) != request_keys or type(ap) is not dict or set(ap) != approval_keys:
        raise Invalid("authority exact schema")
    if rq["kind"] != "rqls10-guard-matrix-request-v1" or ap["kind"] != "rqls10-guard-matrix-invocation-v1":
        raise Invalid("authority kind")
    negative = {"kind": "MODEL_STATE", "case": case, "native_process": False, "native_mutation": False}
    for item in (rq, ap):
        if item["case"] != case or item["scope"] != SCOPE or not same(item["run"], run) or \
                item["hook_set"] != HOOK_SET or not same(item["negative_control"], negative):
            raise Invalid("case/scope/current inode/negative bindings")
    if ap["request_sha256"] != request["sha256"] or ap["authority"] != "PARENT_INDIVIDUAL_INVOCATION_NO_RELEASE" or \
            ap["ownership_negative"] is not False or ap["mutation_negative"] is not False or ap["native_config"] is not None:
        raise Invalid("state authority cannot imply native GO or mutation")
    allocation = rq["allocation"]
    expected_keys = {"bytes", "cpu_slots", "max_wall_s", "rss_bytes", "output_bytes", "busy_limit",
                     "no_three_loops", "outstanding_reservations_bytes", "lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes"}
    if type(allocation) is not dict or set(allocation) != expected_keys or not same(ap["allocation"], allocation) or \
            allocation["cpu_slots"] != 1 or type(allocation["cpu_slots"]) is not int or \
            allocation["bytes"] != MAX_BYTES or type(allocation["bytes"]) is not int or \
            allocation["max_wall_s"] != MAX_RUNTIME or type(allocation["max_wall_s"]) is not float or \
            allocation["rss_bytes"] != RSS_LIMIT or type(allocation["rss_bytes"]) is not int or \
            allocation["output_bytes"] != MAX_BYTES or type(allocation["output_bytes"]) is not int or \
            allocation["busy_limit"] != 2 or type(allocation["busy_limit"]) is not int or \
            allocation["no_three_loops"] is not True or any(not integer(allocation[k]) for k in
                ("outstanding_reservations_bytes", "lane_outstanding_reservations_bytes")):
        raise Invalid("bounded parent allocation")
    now = time.time()  # Native raw epoch telemetry for authority only, never a human timestamp.
    if not finite(rq["not_after_epoch"]) or not same(rq["not_after_epoch"], ap["not_after_epoch"]) or \
            not now <= rq["not_after_epoch"] <= now + MAX_RUNTIME:
        raise Invalid("expired/unbounded authority")
    paths = {"supervisor": SUPERVISOR, "driver": DRIVER, "oracle": ORACLE, "case_specs": SPECS}
    if type(ap["sources"]) is not dict or set(ap["sources"]) != set(paths):
        raise Invalid("source keys")
    sources = {}
    for key, path in paths.items():
        pin = ap["sources"][key]
        if type(pin) is not dict or set(pin) != {"path", "sha256"} or pin["path"] != path or not hex64(pin["sha256"]):
            raise Invalid("source pin schema")
        actual = absolute_snapshot(path, budget)
        if actual["sha256"] != pin["sha256"] or actual["mode"] != 0o444:
            raise Invalid("source not exact frozen bytes")
        sources[key] = actual
    if sources["supervisor"]["sha256"] != SUPERVISOR_SHA:
        raise Invalid("original source SHA")
    spec = decode(sources["case_specs"]["raw"])
    if spec.get("kind") != "rqls10-matrix-state-v1-cases" or set(spec.get("cases", {})) != set(CASES) or \
            spec.get("supervisor") != {"path": SUPERVISOR, "sha256": SUPERVISOR_SHA} or \
            rq["model_inputs_sha256"] != hashlib.sha256(canonical(spec["cases"][case])).hexdigest():
        raise Invalid("fixed case inputs/spec/source pin mismatch")
    return ap, rq, sources, approval, request, spec["cases"][case], now


def utf8_hex(text):
    raw = text.encode("utf-8", "surrogatepass")
    return {"encoding": "UTF8_HEX", "scope": "MODEL_INPUT_NOT_ACTUAL_BIN_DATE", "hex": raw.hex(),
            "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}


def safe(value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if re.search(r"\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d[T ]\d\d:", value):
            return utf8_hex(value)
        return value
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        return {"encoding": "BYTES_HEX", "scope": "MODEL_INPUT_NOT_ACTUAL_BIN_DATE", "hex": value.hex(),
                "bytes": len(value), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): utf8_hex(v) if isinstance(v, str) and
                (str(k) in ("error", "detail", "reason") or str(k).endswith("_error")) else safe(v)
                for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
        return [safe(x) for x in value]
    if isinstance(value, signal.Signals):
        return int(value)
    if value is None or type(value) in (bool, int, float):
        return value
    return {"model_type": type(value).__name__}


def source_frames():
    frame = sys._getframe(1)
    result = []
    while frame is not None:
        if frame.f_code.co_filename == SUPERVISOR:
            result.append((frame.f_code.co_name, frame.f_lineno, frame))
        frame = frame.f_back
    return result


class ModelClock:
    def __init__(self, model):
        self.model = model
        self.mono = MONO
        self.epoch_origin = EPOCH
        self.civil_shift = 0.0
        self.rules = []

    def reading(self, clock):
        self.model.guard()
        stack = source_frames()
        self.model.checkpoint(stack)
        value = self.mono if clock == "monotonic" else self.epoch_origin + self.mono - MONO + self.civil_shift
        for rule in self.rules:
            if rule["fired"] or rule["clock"] != clock or not self.model.matches(stack, rule):
                continue
            rule["seen"] += 1
            if rule["seen"] != rule["occurrence"]:
                continue
            rule["fired"] = True
            rule["mono_before"] = self.mono
            if rule["action"] == "set":
                self.mono = rule["set_to"]
                value = self.mono if clock == "monotonic" else self.epoch_origin + self.mono - MONO + self.civil_shift
            elif rule["action"] == "epoch":
                value = rule["set_to"]
                self.civil_shift = value - (self.epoch_origin + self.mono - MONO)
            elif rule["action"] == "raise":
                rule["returned"], rule["exception_type"] = None, "ModelClockUnavailable"
                self.model.record("clock_rule", dict(rule, response_scope="API_RESPONSE_INJECTION"))
                raise ModelClockUnavailable("MODEL declared clock response unavailable")
            rule["returned"], rule["exception_type"] = value, None
            self.model.record("clock_rule", dict(rule, response_scope="API_RESPONSE_INJECTION"))
        return value

    def monotonic(self):
        return self.reading("monotonic")

    def time(self):
        return self.reading("time")

    def sleep(self, seconds):
        self.model.guard()
        if not finite(seconds) or not 0 <= seconds <= 600:
            self.model.bad("unbounded model sleep")
        # Zero sleep advances one model scheduling quantum; never a native sleep.
        self.mono += max(seconds, 0.000001)
        self.model.record("sleep", {"requested_s": seconds, "model_quantum_s": max(seconds, 0.000001)})


class ModelSignals:
    def __init__(self, model):
        self.model = model
        self.pending = set()
        self.mask = set()
        for key in ("SIGTERM", "SIGINT", "SIGHUP", "SIGPIPE", "SIGCHLD", "SIG_BLOCK", "SIG_SETMASK", "SIG_UNBLOCK"):
            setattr(self, key, getattr(signal, key))

    def sigpending(self):
        self.model.guard()
        self.model.record("sigpending", {"signals": sorted(self.pending)})
        return set(self.pending)

    def pthread_sigmask(self, how, values):
        self.model.guard()
        old = set(self.mask)
        if how == self.SIG_BLOCK:
            self.mask |= set(values)
        elif how == self.SIG_SETMASK:
            self.mask = set(values)
        elif how == self.SIG_UNBLOCK:
            self.mask -= set(values)
        else:
            self.model.bad("signal mask operation")
        self.model.record("sigmask", {"how": int(how), "signals": sorted(values)})
        return old


class ModelJSON:
    """Pure serialization passthrough plus declared read-only source-state checkpoint."""
    def __init__(self, model):
        self.model = model

    def dumps(self, value, *args, **kwargs):
        self.model.guard()
        self.model.checkpoint(source_frames())
        return json.dumps(value, *args, **kwargs)

    @staticmethod
    def loads(value, *args, **kwargs):
        return json.loads(value, *args, **kwargs)


class ModelStream:
    def __init__(self, model, name):
        self.model, self.name = model, name
        self.buffer = ""

    def write(self, text):
        self.model.guard()
        if len(self.buffer.encode()) + len(text.encode()) > 4 << 20:
            self.model.bad("model stream bound")
        self.buffer += text
        self.model.record("stream_write", {"stream": self.name, "bytes": len(text.encode()),
                                           "sha256": hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()})
        return len(text)

    def flush(self):
        self.model.guard()
        self.model.record("stream_flush", {"stream": self.name})


class ModelNode:
    def __init__(self, inode, directory=False, data=b"", logical_size=None):
        self.inode, self.directory = inode, directory
        self.data = bytearray(data)
        self.logical_size = logical_size
        self.nlink = 1
        self.changed = 1

    @property
    def size(self):
        return len(self.data) if self.logical_size is None else self.logical_size


class ModelOS:
    """Only explicit model primitives. There is deliberately no generic native fallback."""
    path = SimpleNamespace(abspath=os.path.abspath, normpath=os.path.normpath, dirname=os.path.dirname,
                           basename=os.path.basename, relpath=os.path.relpath)
    WNOHANG = os.WNOHANG
    for _key in ("O_RDONLY", "O_WRONLY", "O_RDWR", "O_CREAT", "O_EXCL", "O_NOFOLLOW", "O_NONBLOCK",
                 "O_DIRECTORY", "POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2", "POSIX_SPAWN_CLOSE"):
        locals()[_key] = getattr(os, _key)

    def __init__(self, model):
        self.model = model
        self.nodes = {}
        self.fds = {}
        self.nextfd = 10
        self.nextino = 100
        self.free_value = 13000000000
        self.write_mode = None
        self.write_count = 0
        self.ensure_dir("/")

    def getpid(self):
        return MODEL_PID

    def getuid(self):
        return MODEL_UID

    def ensure_dir(self, path):
        path = os.path.normpath(path)
        if path not in self.nodes:
            if path != "/":
                self.ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(path))
            self.nodes[path] = ModelNode(self.nextino, True)
            self.nextino += 1
        return self.nodes[path]

    def put(self, path, data=b"", logical_size=None):
        self.ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(path))
        node = ModelNode(self.nextino, False, data, logical_size)
        self.nextino += 1
        self.nodes[path] = node
        return node

    def resolve(self, path, dir_fd=None):
        if os.path.isabs(path):
            return os.path.normpath(path)
        if dir_fd not in self.fds or self.fds[dir_fd]["kind"] != "file":
            self.model.bad("model relative fd")
        return os.path.normpath(self.fds[dir_fd]["path"] + "/" + path)

    def status(self, node):
        return SimpleNamespace(st_dev=771, st_ino=node.inode, st_size=node.size,
                               st_mode=(stat.S_IFDIR | 0o755) if node.directory else (stat.S_IFREG | 0o644),
                               st_nlink=node.nlink, st_mtime_ns=node.changed, st_ctime_ns=node.changed,
                               st_birthtime=EPOCH - 1000)

    def stat(self, path, dir_fd=None, follow_symlinks=False):
        self.model.guard()
        resolved = self.resolve(path, dir_fd)
        if resolved not in self.nodes:
            raise FileNotFoundError(errno.ENOENT, "MODEL absent file")
        return self.status(self.nodes[resolved])

    def fstat(self, fd):
        self.model.guard()
        item = self.fds.get(fd)
        if item is None or item["kind"] != "file":
            self.model.bad("model fstat descriptor")
        return self.status(item["node"])

    def open(self, path, flags, mode=0o644, dir_fd=None):
        self.model.guard()
        resolved = self.resolve(path, dir_fd)
        if resolved == "/dev/null":
            node = self.nodes.get(resolved) or self.put(resolved)
        elif flags & self.O_CREAT:
            if resolved in self.nodes and flags & self.O_EXCL:
                raise FileExistsError(errno.EEXIST, "MODEL exclusive collision")
            node = self.nodes.get(resolved) or self.put(resolved)
        elif resolved in self.nodes:
            node = self.nodes[resolved]
        else:
            raise FileNotFoundError(errno.ENOENT, "MODEL absent file")
        if flags & self.O_DIRECTORY and not node.directory:
            raise NotADirectoryError(errno.ENOTDIR, "MODEL not directory")
        fd = self.nextfd
        self.nextfd += 1
        self.fds[fd] = {"kind": "file", "path": resolved, "node": node, "offset": 0}
        self.model.record("open", {"fd": fd, "path": resolved, "inode": [771, node.inode], "flags": flags})
        return fd

    def close(self, fd):
        self.model.guard()
        if fd not in self.fds:
            raise OSError(errno.EBADF, "MODEL closed fd")
        item = self.fds.pop(fd)
        if item["kind"] == "pipe_write":
            item["pipe"]["eof"] = not any(p.get("pipe") is item["pipe"] and p.get("hold") and not p.get("term")
                                          for p in self.model.procs.values())
        self.model.record("close", {"fd": fd})

    def pipe(self):
        self.model.guard()
        pipe = {"data": bytearray(), "eof": False}
        left, right = self.nextfd, self.nextfd + 1
        self.nextfd += 2
        self.fds[left] = {"kind": "pipe_read", "pipe": pipe, "offset": 0}
        self.fds[right] = {"kind": "pipe_write", "pipe": pipe, "offset": 0}
        self.model.record("pipe", {"read_fd": left, "write_fd": right})
        return left, right

    def read(self, fd, count):
        self.model.guard()
        item = self.fds[fd]
        if item["kind"] == "pipe_read":
            pipe = item["pipe"]
            data = bytes(pipe["data"][item["offset"]:item["offset"] + count])
            if not data and not pipe["eof"]:
                raise BlockingIOError(errno.EAGAIN, "MODEL pipe alive")
        elif item["kind"] == "file":
            if item["node"].logical_size is not None:
                self.model.bad("virtual accounting-only file read")
            data = bytes(item["node"].data[item["offset"]:item["offset"] + count])
        else:
            self.model.bad("model read direction")
        item["offset"] += len(data)
        self.model.record("read", {"fd": fd, "requested": count, "returned": len(data),
                                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
        return data

    def write(self, fd, data):
        self.model.guard()
        self.write_count += 1
        raw = bytes(data)
        count = min(2, len(raw)) if self.write_mode == "short" else 0 if self.write_mode == "zero" else len(raw)
        part = raw[:count]
        item = self.fds[fd]
        if item["kind"] == "pipe_write":
            item["pipe"]["data"].extend(part)
        elif item["kind"] == "file":
            start = item["offset"]
            item["node"].data[start:start + count] = part
            item["node"].changed += 1
            item["offset"] += count
        else:
            self.model.bad("model write direction")
        before = self.model.clock.mono
        if self.write_mode == "late":
            self.model.clock.mono = self.model.write_cutoff + 0.01
        self.model.record("write", {"fd": fd, "requested": len(raw), "returned": count,
                                     "mono_before": before, "mono_after": self.model.clock.mono,
                                     "sha256": hashlib.sha256(part).hexdigest(), "response_scope": "API_RESPONSE_INJECTION"})
        return count

    def fsync(self, fd):
        self.model.guard()
        if fd not in self.fds:
            self.model.bad("model fsync closed fd")
        self.model.record("fsync", {"fd": fd})

    def set_blocking(self, fd, value):
        self.model.guard()
        if fd not in self.fds:
            self.model.bad("model set_blocking fd")
        self.model.record("set_blocking", {"fd": fd, "value": value})

    def fstatvfs(self, fd):
        self.model.guard()
        return SimpleNamespace(f_bavail=self.free_value, f_frsize=1)

    def scandir(self, fd):
        self.model.guard()
        path = self.fds[fd]["path"]
        names = sorted({p[len(path.rstrip("/")) + 1:].split("/", 1)[0] for p in self.nodes
                        if p.startswith(path.rstrip("/") + "/") and p != path})
        @contextlib.contextmanager
        def listing():
            yield iter([SimpleNamespace(name=name) for name in names])
        return listing()

    def link(self, source, target, src_dir_fd=None, dst_dir_fd=None):
        self.model.guard()
        left, right = self.resolve(source, src_dir_fd), self.resolve(target, dst_dir_fd)
        if right in self.nodes:
            raise FileExistsError(errno.EEXIST, "MODEL link collision")
        self.nodes[right] = self.nodes[left]
        self.nodes[right].nlink += 1
        self.model.record("link", {"source": left, "target": right, "inode": [771, self.nodes[right].inode]})

    def posix_spawn(self, path, argv, env, file_actions, setsid, setsigmask, setsigdef):
        self.model.guard()
        if not setsid or setsigmask != ():
            self.model.bad("model spawn mask/session")
        helper = path == "/bin/date"
        if not helper and argv != self.model.cfg["argv"]:
            self.model.bad("model arbitrary command")
        pid = self.model.next_helper if helper else MODEL_MAIN
        if helper:
            self.model.next_helper += 1
        p = self.model.process(pid)
        p["helper"] = helper
        p["hold"] = self.model.helper_holds if helper else True
        p.update(self.model.spawn_overrides.get("helper" if helper else "child", {}))
        self.model.procs[pid] = p
        if helper:
            text = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(math.floor(self.model.clock.time()), datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
            for action in file_actions:
                if action[0] == self.POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2 and action[2] == 1:
                    pipe = self.fds[action[1]]["pipe"]
                    pipe["data"].extend(text.encode("ascii") + b"\n")
                    pipe["eof"] = not self.model.helper_holds
                    p["pipe"] = pipe
        self.model.record("posix_spawn", {"pid": pid, "pgid": pid, "argv": argv, "setsid": setsid,
                                           "setsigmask": list(setsigmask), "helper": helper,
                                           "scope": "MODEL_PROCESS_NOT_NATIVE"})
        return pid

    WIFEXITED = staticmethod(os.WIFEXITED)
    WIFSIGNALED = staticmethod(os.WIFSIGNALED)

    def waitpid(self, pid, flags):
        self.model.guard()
        if flags != self.WNOHANG:
            self.model.bad("non-WNOHANG model wait")
        before = self.model.clock.mono
        if self.model.wait_return_mono is not None and pid == MODEL_MAIN:
            self.model.clock.mono = self.model.wait_return_mono
            result = (pid, 0)
            self.model.procs.pop(pid, None)
            self.model.wait_return_mono = None
        else:
            p = self.model.procs.get(pid)
            if p is None:
                raise ChildProcessError("MODEL wait ownership absent")
            if p.get("term"):
                result = (pid, int(signal.SIGTERM))
                self.model.procs.pop(pid)
                if p.get("pipe") is not None:
                    p["pipe"]["eof"] = True
            elif p.get("helper") and not p.get("hold"):
                result = (pid, 0)
                self.model.procs.pop(pid)
            else:
                result = (0, 0)
        self.model.record("waitpid", {"pid": pid, "flags": flags, "mono_before": before,
                                       "mono_after": self.model.clock.mono, "returned": list(result)})
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def waitstatus_to_exitcode(status):
        return os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)  # Pure status decoder, not a process operation.

    def killpg(self, pgid, sig):
        self.model.guard()
        if sig != signal.SIGTERM:
            self.model.bad("model escalation")
        matches = [p for p in self.model.procs.values() if p["pgid"] == pgid]
        if not matches:
            raise ProcessLookupError(errno.ESRCH, "MODEL group absent")
        for p in matches:
            p["term"] = True
        self.model.record("killpg", {"pgid": pgid, "signal": int(sig), "scope": "MODEL_SIGNAL_NOT_NATIVE"})

    def __getattr__(self, name):
        self.model.bad("unmodelled os operation " + name)


class ModelLP:
    def __init__(self, model):
        self.model = model

    def proc_listallpids(self, buf, size):
        self.model.guard()
        if buf is None:
            self.model.scan_begin()
        pids = sorted(self.model.procs)
        if buf is not None:
            for i, pid in enumerate(pids):
                buf[i] = pid
        self.model.record("proc_listallpids", {"pids": pids, "capacity_bytes": size})
        return len(pids)

    def proc_pidinfo(self, pid, flavor, zombies, buf, size):
        self.model.guard()
        stack = source_frames()
        self.model.checkpoint(stack)
        self.model.metadata_read(pid, stack)
        p = self.model.procs.get(pid)
        error = self.model.flavor_errors.get((pid, flavor))
        if p is None or pid in self.model.ident_errors or error is not None:
            ctypes.set_errno(error or (errno.EACCES if pid in self.model.ident_errors else errno.ESRCH))
            self.model.record("proc_pidinfo", {"pid": pid, "flavor": flavor, "returned": 0,
                                               "model_errno": ctypes.get_errno()})
            return 0
        raw = bytearray(size)
        if flavor == 17 and size == 56:
            struct.pack_into("=Q", raw, 16, p["uniqueid"])
            struct.pack_into("=i", raw, 32, p["idversion"])
        elif flavor == 13 and size == 64:
            struct.pack_into("=IIII", raw, 0, pid, p["ppid"], p["pgid"], p["status"])
            raw[16:32] = p["comm"].encode()[:15].ljust(16, b"\0")
            struct.pack_into("=II", raw, 32, 2 if p["traced"] else 0, p["euid"])
            struct.pack_into("=I", raw, 44, p["ruid"])
        elif flavor == 4 and size == 96:
            ticks = int(max(0.0, self.model.clock.time() - p["start_epoch"]) * 1e9 * p["cpu_rate"])
            struct.pack_into("=QQQ", raw, 8, p["rss"], ticks, 0)
        elif flavor == 3 and size == 136:
            seconds = int(p["start_epoch"])
            struct.pack_into("=QQ", raw, 120, seconds, 0)
        elif flavor == 9 and size == 2352:
            cwd = self.model.cfg["lane"].encode() + b"\0"
            raw[152:152 + len(cwd)] = cwd
        else:
            self.model.bad("unmodelled libproc flavor")
        buf.raw = bytes(raw)
        self.model.record("proc_pidinfo", {"pid": pid, "flavor": flavor, "returned": size,
                                           "identity": self.model.identity(p)})
        return size


class ModelLC:
    def __init__(self, model):
        self.model = model

    def mach_timebase_info(self, pointer):
        self.model.guard()
        pointer._obj.numer, pointer._obj.denom = 1, 1
        return 0

    def sysctl(self, mib, count, out, size, new, length):
        self.model.guard()
        if list(mib) == [1, 8]:
            out._obj.value = 1 << 20
            size._obj.value = ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_int)
            return 0
        if count == 3 and list(mib)[:2] == [1, 49]:
            raw = struct.pack("=i", 1) + b"/MODEL/python\0\0/MODEL/python\0"
            out.raw = raw.ljust(len(out), b"\0")
            size._obj.value = len(raw)
            return 0
        self.model.bad("unmodelled sysctl")


class Model:
    def __init__(self, budget, source_raw):
        self.budget, self.source_raw = budget, source_raw
        budget.model = self  # Preserve partial raw evidence if a fixed boundary is not reached.
        self.calls = 0
        self.operations = []
        self.op_hash = hashlib.sha256()
        self.verbose = True
        self.violations = []
        self.halted = False
        self.clock = ModelClock(self)
        self.signals = ModelSignals(self)
        self.os = ModelOS(self)
        self.stdout, self.stderr = ModelStream(self, "stdout"), ModelStream(self, "stderr")
        self.procs = {1: self.process(1, 0)}
        self.ident_errors = set()
        self.flavor_errors, self.transitions, self.spawn_overrides = {}, [], {}
        self.next_helper = 700000100
        self.helper_holds = False
        self.wait_return_mono = None
        self.scan_mode = None
        self.top_scans = 0
        self.checkpoint_mode = None
        self.mark = None
        self.calibration = False
        self.s = None
        self.ns = None
        self.cfg = None
        self.inputs = {}
        self.steps = []
        self.disclosures = []

    def guard(self):
        if self.halted:
            raise CalibrationStop()
        self.calls += 1
        if self.calls > 1500000:
            raise BudgetStop("model operation ceiling")
        if self.calls % 128 == 0:
            self.budget.check()

    def bad(self, reason):
        self.violations.append(reason)
        raise ModelBoundary(reason)

    def record(self, operation, fields):
        event = {"index": self.calls, "operation": operation, "scope": "MODEL_INPUT", **safe(fields)}
        self.op_hash.update(canonical(event))
        if self.verbose:
            if len(self.operations) >= 16000:
                self.bad("model retained trace ceiling")
            self.operations.append(event)

    @staticmethod
    def process(pid, uid=MODEL_UID):
        return {"pid": pid, "uniqueid": pid + 1000000000, "idversion": 1, "ppid": MODEL_PID if pid != 1 else 0,
                "pgid": pid, "status": 2, "euid": uid, "ruid": uid, "traced": False, "comm": "MODEL",
                "rss": 4096, "cpu_rate": 0.0, "start_epoch": EPOCH - 100.0}

    @staticmethod
    def identity(p):
        return {k: p[k] for k in ("pid", "ppid", "pgid", "status", "euid", "ruid", "traced", "comm", "uniqueid", "idversion")}

    def site(self, function, snippet):
        nodes = [n for n in ast.walk(self.tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name == function]
        if len(nodes) != 1:
            raise ModelBoundary("ambiguous source symbol " + function)
        node = nodes[0]
        lines = self.source_raw.decode().splitlines()
        hits = [n for n in range(node.lineno, node.end_lineno + 1) if snippet in lines[n - 1]]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            raise ModelBoundary("missing/ambiguous source anchor " + function + ":" + snippet)
        return hits[0]

    @staticmethod
    def matches(stack, rule):
        if not any(name == rule["function"] and line == rule["line"] for name, line, _ in stack):
            return False
        return all(any(name == item["function"] and (item["line"] is None or line == item["line"])
                       for name, line, _ in stack) for item in rule.get("within", []))

    def within(self, function, snippet=None):
        return {"function": function, "snippet": snippet, "line": None if snippet is None else self.site(function, snippet)}

    def clock_rule(self, function, snippet, value=None, occurrence=1, clock="monotonic", action="set", within=()):
        rule = {"function": function, "snippet": snippet, "line": self.site(function, snippet),
                "clock": clock, "action": action, "within": list(within),
                "set_to": value, "occurrence": occurrence, "seen": 0, "fired": False,
                "returned": None, "exception_type": None}
        self.clock.rules.append(rule)
        return rule

    def transition(self, pid, field, value, after_reads=0, source=None):
        rule = {"pid": pid, "field": field, "value": value, "after_reads": after_reads,
                "source": source, "seen": 0, "fired": False}
        self.transitions.append(rule)
        return rule

    def metadata_read(self, pid, stack):
        for rule in self.transitions:
            if rule["fired"] or pid != rule["pid"]:
                continue
            if rule["source"] is not None and not any(
                    name == "acquire_identity" and frame.f_locals.get("source") == rule["source"]
                    for name, _, frame in stack):
                continue
            if rule["seen"] == rule["after_reads"]:
                p = self.procs[pid]
                rule["before"] = self.identity(p)
                p[rule["field"]] = rule["value"]
                rule["after"], rule["fired"] = self.identity(p), True
                self.record("metadata_transition", dict(rule, response_scope="API_RESPONSE_INJECTION"))
            rule["seen"] += 1

    def checkpoint(self, stack):
        if self.mark is not None or self.checkpoint_mode is None or self.s is None:
            return
        found = False
        if self.checkpoint_mode in ("final_rss", "initial_main"):
            wanted = "measurement_final_bracket" if self.checkpoint_mode == "final_rss" else "main_initial"
            found = any(name == "retain_identity" and frame.f_locals.get("source") == wanted for name, _, frame in stack)
        elif self.checkpoint_mode == "helper_term":
            found = any(name == "census" for name, _, _ in stack) and self.s.in_helper
        if not found:
            return
        self.mark = {"mode": self.checkpoint_mode, "history_charge_before": self.s.history_charge,
                     "mono_before": self.clock.mono, "stack": [{"symbol": n, "line": line} for n, line, _ in stack]}
        self.record("history_checkpoint", self.mark)
        if self.calibration:
            self.halted = True
            raise CalibrationStop()

    def scan_begin(self):
        if self.s is None or self.s.in_helper:
            return
        stack = source_frames()
        if not any(name == "census" for name, _, _ in stack):
            return
        self.top_scans += 1
        self.ident_errors.clear()
        if self.scan_mode and self.top_scans == 1:
            unknown, broken = self.process(700000030), self.process(700000031, 0)
            if self.scan_mode == "unproved":
                self.procs[unknown["pid"]] = unknown
            elif self.scan_mode == "busy":
                self.procs[MODEL_MAIN]["cpu_rate"] = 1.0
                other = self.process(700000020)
                other["cpu_rate"] = 1.0
                self.procs[other["pid"]] = other
                acquired = self.s.observed_identity(other["pid"], "MODEL_RUNNING_EXTRA", True)
                self.s.register_owned(acquired, "child")
                self.disclosures.append("Declared MODEL listing-callback insertion: extra pid700000020 is acquired/registered by original methods before listing return; no native sampled-ownership claim.")
            elif self.scan_mode == "rss":
                self.procs[MODEL_MAIN]["rss"] = self.cfg["rss_trip_bytes"] + 1
            self.procs[broken["pid"]] = broken
            self.ident_errors.add(broken["pid"])
        elif self.scan_mode and self.top_scans > 1:
            for pid in (700000020, 700000030, 700000031):
                self.procs.pop(pid, None)
            if MODEL_MAIN in self.procs:
                self.procs[MODEL_MAIN].update(rss=4096, cpu_rate=0.0)
