            s.cfg = dict(cfg, lane=device["path"])
            event("readonly_lane_method_overlay", "MODIFIED_QUALIFICATION_FIXTURE", original_lane=cfg["lane"],
                  approved_existing_lane=device["path"], source_method="Supervisor.verify_anchors")
            s.open_anchors()
        else:
            s.open_anchors()
        if case in ("io_root_swap", "io_subtree_swap"):
            paths = anchors(case, RUN)
            target = paths["charge"] if case == "io_root_swap" else paths["out"]
            archived = RUN + "/scratch/" + ("root.original" if case == "io_root_swap" else "out.original")
            marker = target + "/fixture-marker.txt"
            created = exclusive(marker, b"fresh bounded fixture marker\n")
            if os.path.lexists(archived):
                raise FileExistsError("directory archive exists")
            before = directory(target)
            try:
                original_inode = ident(before)
            finally:
                os.close(before)
            os.rename(target, archived)
            os.mkdir(target, 0o700)
            if case == "io_root_swap":
                os.mkdir(target + "/out", 0o700)
                os.mkdir(target + "/tmp", 0o700)
            replacement = exclusive(marker, b"fresh bounded fixture marker\n")
            after = directory(target)
            try:
                replacement_inode = ident(after)
            finally:
                os.close(after)
            event("native_directory_replacement", target=target, archive=archived, original_inode=original_inode,
                  replacement_inode=replacement_inode, original_marker=created, replacement_marker=replacement,
                  no_old_or_approval_objects_moved=True)
            s.verify_anchors(env["Deadline"](1, WORK_END - 0.1))
        elif case in CHANNEL + TYPE_GO + TYPE_PREP + NEGATIVE_KEYS:
            result["method_return"] = s.authorization_io(env["Deadline"](1, WORK_END - 0.1))
            if case in TYPE_PREP:
                result["method_return"] = s.creation_manifest(env["Deadline"](1, WORK_END - 0.1))
    except BaseException as exc:
        result["exception"] = exception(exc)
        event("original_method_exception", error=exception(exc), source_method=("validate/authorization_io/creation_manifest" if case in CHANNEL + TYPE_GO + TYPE_PREP + NEGATIVE_KEYS else "verify_anchors"))
    return result


def artifact_inventory():
    result = []
    seen_paths = set()
    def visit(path, depth=0):
        check("artifact inventory")
        if depth > 12 or len(result) >= 1024:
            raise OSError("artifact inventory cap")
        try:
            fd = directory(path)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            result.append({"path": path, "missing": True})
            return
        try:
            result.append({"path": path, "directory_inode": ident(fd)})
            names = sorted(os.listdir(fd))
            for name in names:
                child = path + "/" + name
                value = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
                if stat.S_ISDIR(value.st_mode):
                    visit(child, depth + 1)
                elif stat.S_ISREG(value.st_mode):
                    result.append(read_regular(child, OUTPUT_CAP)[0])
                else:
                    result.append({"path": child, "inode": [value.st_dev, value.st_ino], "mode_raw": value.st_mode,
                                   "unsupported_artifact": True})
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
    for path in ARTIFACT_ROOTS:
        if path not in seen_paths:
            seen_paths.add(path)
            visit(path)
    for name in ("GO.json", "GO.archived.json", "pinned-scratch.txt", "child-ready.json", "child-open-release.json"):
        path = RUN + "/" + name
        try:
            result.append(read_regular(path, OUTPUT_CAP)[0])
        except FileNotFoundError:
            result.append({"path": path, "missing": True})
    return result


def close_source_descriptors(proxy):
    # Only descriptors created/opened by this source namespace. No generic fd
    # sweep and no close of parent captures/standard descriptors.
    if STATE is not None:
        for record in STATE.keep:
            if record.get("pid") is not None and not (record.get("leader_reaped") or
                    (record is STATE.child and STATE.rc is not None)):
                UNRESOLVED.append({"kind": "source_owned_process", "pid": record["pid"],
                                   "identity": record.get("identity") or STATE.ident,
                                   "role": record["role"], "reason": "source return is not endedness proof"})
        for thread in STATE.threads:
            if thread.is_alive():
                UNRESOLVED.append({"kind": "source_sink_thread", "name": thread.name})
    if any(x["kind"] == "source_sink_thread" for x in UNRESOLVED):
        UNRESOLVED.append({"kind": "source_fds", "reason": "live source thread retains its owned descriptors"})
        return
    for fd, info in list(proxy.fds.items()):
        if fd < 3:
            continue
        try:
            if ident(fd) != info["inode"]:
                UNRESOLVED.append({"kind": "fd_identity_changed", "fd": fd, "expected": info})
                continue
            os.close(fd)
            event("fixture_closes_source_owned_fd", fd=fd, original=info)
        except OSError as exc:
            event("fixture_source_fd_close_error", fd=fd, original=info, error=exception(exc))
        proxy.fds.pop(fd, None)


def write_pre_b_record():
    if REC_AT_B is None:
        return
    if isinstance(REC_AT_B, bytes):
        facts = exclusive(RUN + "/scratch/pre-b-record.json", REC_AT_B)
        event("pre_b_record_artifact", artifact=facts, scope_label="SOURCE_RECORD_BEFORE_ORIGINAL_B_ACCOUNTING")
    else:
        UNRESOLVED.append({"kind": "pre_b_record_truncated", **REC_AT_B})


def write_outcome(case, trusted, source_outcome, selected, source_main_called):
    if TRUNCATED["events"]:
        UNRESOLVED.append({"kind": "event_trace_truncated", "dropped_events": TRUNCATED["events"],
                           "first_dropped_operation": TRUNCATED["first_operation"]})
    if ENVELOPE_REFUSAL is not None:
        UNRESOLVED.append({"kind": "fixture_envelope_refusal", **ENVELOPE_REFUSAL})
    payload = {"kind": "rqls10-guard-matrix-outcome-v1", "case": case, "scope": "MODIFIED_QUALIFICATION_FIXTURE",
               "bindings": {"approval_sha256": trusted, "request_sha256": APPROVAL["request_sha256"],
                            "request_created": APPROVAL["request_created"],
                            "sources": REQUEST["sources"], "config": REQUEST["config"], "go_original": REQUEST["go_original"],
                            "go": REQUEST["go"], "stability": REQUEST["stability"], "preparation": REQUEST["preparation"],
                            "anchors": REQUEST["anchors"], "allocation": REQUEST["allocation"],
                            "hook_set": REQUEST["hook_set"], "negative_control": REQUEST["negative_control"]},
               "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "pgid": os.getpgrp(), "mono_begin": BEGIN, "mono_end": time.monotonic()},
               "observations": EVENTS, "source_outcome": source_outcome, "source_state": source_state(),
               "accounting": accounting_snapshot(), "artifacts": artifact_inventory(), "unresolved": UNRESOLVED,
               "missing_prerequisites": PREREQUISITES, "selected_status_not_actual_exit": selected,
               "original_main_called": source_main_called, "evidence_complete": not bool(UNRESOLVED),
               "terminal": {"source_sha256": SUP_SHA, "ast_lines": TERMINAL_LINES, "unchanged": True,
                            "actual_exit_authority": "independent parent capture only; actual14 never120"},
               "limits": REQUEST["limits"], "observed_maxrss_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
               "authority": "NO_GO_NO_RELEASE_NO_SCIENCE_ACCEPTANCE"}
    data = packed(payload)
    if len(data) > 8 << 20:
        payload = {k: payload[k] for k in ("kind", "case", "scope", "bindings", "owner", "terminal", "limits", "authority")}
        payload.update(evidence_complete=False, oversized_original_bytes=len(data), oversized_original_sha256=sha(data),
                       unresolved=[{"kind": "outcome_oversized"}], selected_status_not_actual_exit=selected)
        data = packed(payload)
    exclusive(RUN + "/fixture-outcome.json", data)


def run(case, trusted):
    global SELECTED, APPROVED_CFG
    cfg = authorize(case, trusted)
    APPROVED_CFG = cfg
    env, proxy, terminal = source_load()
    install_hooks(env, proxy)
    original_main = env["main"]
    stderr_fixture = None
    if case in POST:
        stderr_fixture = NativeStderr(case)
        sys.stderr = stderr_fixture
    else:
        sys.stderr = BoundedStdout(ORIGINAL_STDERR, "stderr")
    sys.stdout = BoundedStdout(ORIGINAL_STDOUT)
    method_only = case in METHOD
    def fixture_main():
        global SELECTED, REPORTING
        outcome = None
        try:
            if method_only:
                outcome = method_fixture(cfg)
                SELECTED = 0  # Method transport only; original method exception is independently checked.
            else:
                old_argv = sys.argv
                sys.argv = [SUP, REQUEST["config"]["path"]]
                try:
                    SELECTED = original_main()
                finally:
                    sys.argv = old_argv
                outcome = {"mode": "ORIGINAL_FULL_MAIN_WITH_FIXED_OVERLAY", "selected_source_return": SELECTED,
                           "exception": None, "original_main_called": True}
        except BaseException as exc:
            SELECTED = 2
            outcome = {"mode": "FIXTURE_EXCEPTION", "exception": exception(exc), "original_main_called": not method_only}
            UNRESOLVED.append({"kind": "fixture_exception", "error": exception(exc)})
        REPORTING = True  # Source work ended; only bounded evidence/reporting may use the reserve.
        # Reporting failures are retained (or leave a missing outcome => parent HOLD); they never
        # change the selected source status handed to the unchanged original terminal.
        safe_hook("finish_descriptor_fault_window", proxy.end_window, "main_returned_before_expected_close")
        if stderr_fixture is not None:
            safe_hook("persistent_stderr_probes", stderr_fixture.persistent_probes)
            safe_hook("retain_stderr_until_terminal", stderr_fixture.retain_until_terminal)
        safe_hook("write_pre_b_record", write_pre_b_record)
        safe_hook("close_source_descriptors", close_source_descriptors, proxy)
        safe_hook("write_outcome", write_outcome, case, trusted, outcome, SELECTED, not method_only)
        # The original terminal now sees this result. Never translate14 to0/120,
        # and never call normal sys.exit instead of original source19 _exit14.
        return SELECTED
    env["main"] = fixture_main
    env["__name__"] = "__main__"
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[terminal], type_ignores=[]), SUP, "exec"), env)

def typed_equal(a, b):
    if type(a) is not type(b):
        return False
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        return set(a) == set(b) and all(typed_equal(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a, list):
        return len(a) == len(b) and all(typed_equal(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    return a == b


def original_created(wanted, actual):
    if not isinstance(wanted, dict) or set(wanted) != {"path", "inode", "bytes", "sha256", "nlink", "creation_ordinal"} or \
            type(wanted["creation_ordinal"]) is not int or wanted["creation_ordinal"] < 0 or \
            not all(typed_equal(wanted[k], actual[k]) for k in ("path", "inode", "bytes", "sha256", "nlink")) or \
            type(wanted["nlink"]) is not int or wanted["nlink"] != 1:
        raise ValueError("original created descriptor continuity")

def check(where):
    if (CANCELLED and not REPORTING) or time.monotonic() >= (LIFE - 0.05 if REPORTING else DEADLINE):
        raise OSError("CHILD_COOPERATIVE_DEADLINE_OR_TERM " + where)

        raise OSError("CHILD_RSS_OVER_256M")


def pairs(items):
    out = {}
    for key, value in items:
        if key in out:
            raise ValueError("duplicate JSON key")
        out[key] = value
    return out


def decode(raw):
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                      parse_constant=lambda x: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("nonfinite JSON")))


def packed(obj):
    return (json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def err(exc):
    raw = str(exc).encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
    return {"type": type(exc).__name__, "errno": getattr(exc, "errno", None),
            "UTF8_HEX": raw[:16384].hex(), "utf8_bytes": len(raw),
            "text_scope": "MODEL_INPUT_NOT_ACTUAL_BIN_DATE"}


def event(operation, **facts):
    # Never raises into frozen base-method paths; truncation is reported as unresolved evidence.
    value = {"seq": len(EVENTS), "operation": operation, "scope": "NATIVE_OBSERVATION",
             "mono": time.monotonic(), **facts}
    try:
        raw = packed(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raw = None
    if raw is None or len(EVENTS) >= 512 or len(raw) > 1 << 16:
        TRUNCATED[0] += 1
    else:
        EVENTS.append(decode(raw))
    return value


def directory(path):
    if not path.startswith("/") or os.path.normpath(path) != path:
        raise ValueError("noncanonical path")
    fd = os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        for name in path.split("/")[1:]:
            check("directory traversal")
            child = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
            os.close(fd)
            fd = child
        return fd
    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)
        raise


def inode(fd):
    value = os.fstat(fd)
    return [value.st_dev, value.st_ino]


def regular(path, cap=1 << 20):
    parent = directory(os.path.dirname(path))
    fd = None
    try:
        fd = os.open(os.path.basename(path), os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
        st = os.fstat(fd)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or not 0 <= st.st_size <= cap:
            raise ValueError("not bounded regular")
        raw = bytearray()
        while len(raw) < st.st_size:
            check("regular read")
            part = os.read(fd, min(65536, st.st_size - len(raw)))
            if not part:
                raise OSError("short read")
            raw.extend(part)
        end = os.fstat(fd)
        if os.read(fd, 1) or (st.st_dev, st.st_ino, st.st_size, st.st_mtime_ns, st.st_ctime_ns) != \
                (end.st_dev, end.st_ino, end.st_size, end.st_mtime_ns, end.st_ctime_ns):
            raise OSError("changed regular")
        named = os.stat(os.path.basename(path), dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        if (named.st_dev, named.st_ino, named.st_size, named.st_mtime_ns, named.st_ctime_ns) != \
                (end.st_dev, end.st_ino, end.st_size, end.st_mtime_ns, end.st_ctime_ns):
            raise OSError("original regular pathname replaced during read")
        return {"path": path, "inode": [st.st_dev, st.st_ino], "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha(raw), "nlink": st.st_nlink}, bytes(raw)
    finally:
        if fd is not None:
            os.close(fd)
        os.close(parent)


def write(fd, raw):
    old = os.get_blocking(fd)
    os.set_blocking(fd, False)
    view = memoryview(raw)
    try:
        while view:
            check("native bounded child write")
            try:
                count = os.write(fd, view[:65536])
            except BlockingIOError:
                time.sleep(0.002)
                continue
            if count <= 0:
                raise OSError("zero write")
            view = view[count:]
    finally:
        os.set_blocking(fd, old)


def create(path, raw):
    if len(raw) > 1 << 18:
        raise ValueError("bounded child evidence/barrier cap256KiB")
    parent = directory(os.path.dirname(path))
    fd = None
    try:
        fd = os.open(os.path.basename(path), os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, dir_fd=parent)
        created = inode(fd)
        write(fd, raw)
        os.fsync(fd)
        got = os.pread(fd, len(raw) + 1, 0)
        if got != raw or inode(fd) != created:
            raise OSError("child created-descriptor readback mismatch")
        facts = {"path": path, "inode": created, "sha256": sha(got), "bytes": len(got), "nlink": os.fstat(fd).st_nlink}
        os.close(fd)
        fd = None
        os.fsync(parent)
        return facts
    finally:
        if fd is not None:
            os.close(fd)
        os.close(parent)

class OriginalOS:
    def __init__(self):
        self.target_fds = set()
    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(os, name)
    def open(self, path, flags, mode=0o777, *, dir_fd=None):
        before = time.monotonic()
        fd = os.open(path, flags, mode, dir_fd=dir_fd)
        if path in ("pinned-scratch.txt", "launch.json") and flags & os.O_RDWR:
            self.target_fds.add(fd)
            try:
                observed = inode(fd)
            except OSError as exc:
                observed = {"error": err(exc)}
            event("original_target_open", fd=fd, basename=path, flags=flags, inode=observed,
                  mono_before=before, mono_after=time.monotonic())
        return fd
    def write(self, fd, data):
        before = time.monotonic()
        try:
            result = os.write(fd, data)
        except BaseException as exc:
            if fd in self.target_fds:
                event("original_target_write_error", fd=fd, error=err(exc), mono_before=before, mono_after=time.monotonic())
            raise
        if fd in self.target_fds:
            event("original_target_write_return", fd=fd, bytes=len(data), result=result,
                  data_sha256=sha(data), mono_before=before, mono_after=time.monotonic())
        return result
    def close(self, fd):
        try:
            return os.close(fd)
        finally:
            self.target_fds.discard(fd)


def original_child():
    raw = regular(BASE, 2 << 20)[1]
    if sha(raw) != BASE_SHA:
        raise ValueError("immutable base changed before load")
    tree = ast.parse(raw, filename=BASE)
    terminal = tree.body[-1]
    if not isinstance(terminal, ast.If) or not isinstance(terminal.test, ast.Compare) or \
            not isinstance(terminal.test.left, ast.Name) or terminal.test.left.id != "__name__" or \
            len(terminal.test.comparators) != 1 or not isinstance(terminal.test.comparators[0], ast.Constant) or terminal.test.comparators[0].value != "__main__":
        raise ValueError("fixed pinned original child12 terminal guard")
    namespace = {"__file__": BASE, "__name__": "__matrix_original_child12__"}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=tree.body[:-1], type_ignores=[]), BASE, "exec"), namespace)
    namespace["os"] = OriginalOS()
    event("original_child_loaded", source_sha256=BASE_SHA, original_methods=["wait_go", "mutate_original"],
          scope_label="MODIFIED_QUALIFICATION_FIXTURE; original module sans terminal, native observation proxy only")
    return namespace


def ordinary_extra_probe(original):
    # Controlled native pipe, original parser, no strengthened toy parser.
    saved, rd, wr = None, None, None
    try:
        saved = os.dup(0)
        rd, wr = os.pipe()
        write(wr, b"GO\nEXTRA\n")
        os.close(wr)
        wr = None
        os.dup2(rd, 0)
        os.close(rd)
        rd = None
        value = {"input_utf8_hex": b"GO\nEXTRA\n".hex(), "scope": "MODEL_INPUT_NOT_ACTUAL_BIN_DATE",
                 "source_sha256": BASE_SHA, "source_method": "wait_go", "exception": None, "return": None}
        try:
            value["return"] = original["wait_go"]("ok", DEADLINE)
        except BaseException as exc:
            value["exception"] = err(exc)
        return value
    finally:
        if saved is not None:
            os.dup2(saved, 0)
            os.close(saved)
        if rd is not None:
            os.close(rd)
        if wr is not None:
            os.close(wr)


def wait_open_barrier(run, case, manifest_sha):
    expected = {"kind": "rqls10-fixture-open-barrier-v1", "case": case, "child_pid": os.getpid(), "manifest_sha256": manifest_sha}
    while True:
        check("bounded fixture open barrier")  # Raises at the life deadline or after a handled TERM.
        try:
            facts, raw = regular(run + "/child-open-release.json")
            value = decode(raw)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            time.sleep(0.002)  # Absent or still being exclusively written: bounded retry.
            continue
        if value != expected:
            raise ValueError("open barrier is not exact fixture coordination")
        event("native_open_barrier_observed", artifact=facts, authority="NOT_GO_NOT_ADMISSION_NOT_RELEASE")
        return


def main(mode, case):
    global REPORTING
    run, request, trusted = authorize(mode, case)
    original = original_child()
    scenario = ("mutate_pin" if "_pin_" in case else "mutate_evidence") if mode in ("mutation", "channel") else "ok"
    report = {"kind": "rqls10-matrix-io-child-outcome-v1", "case": case, "mode": mode,
              "scope": "MODIFIED_QUALIFICATION_FIXTURE", "approval_sha256": trusted,
              "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "pgid": os.getpgrp(), "mono_entry": ENTRY},
              "base_source_sha256": BASE_SHA, "base_pin_fixture_sha256": sha(original["FIXTURE"]), "protocol": None, "manifest": None,
              "method_return": None, "method_exception": None, "ordinary_extra_probe": None,
              "observations": EVENTS, "unresolved": [], "selected_status_not_actual_exit": None}
    status = 0
    rfd, ofd = None, None
    try:
        protocol, manifest = original["wait_go"](scenario, DEADLINE)
        report["protocol"], report["manifest"] = protocol, manifest
        event("actual_source_go_parser_return", protocol=protocol, manifest=manifest)
        if mode == "wire":
            if case == "io_channel_ordinary":
                report["ordinary_extra_probe"] = ordinary_extra_probe(original)
        elif mode == "mutation":
            if case.endswith("before_child_open"):
                ready = create(run + "/child-ready.json", packed({"kind": "rqls10-matrix-child-open-ready-v1",
                               "case": case, "pid": os.getpid(), "pgid": os.getpgrp(), "mono": time.monotonic(),
                               "manifest_sha256": protocol["creation_manifest_sha256"]}))
                event("native_manifest_received_before_target_open", artifact=ready, manifest_sha256=protocol["creation_manifest_sha256"])
                wait_open_barrier(run, case, protocol["creation_manifest_sha256"])
            rfd = original["directory"](run, DEADLINE)
            ofd = os.open("out", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=rfd)
            report["method_return"] = original["mutate_original"](scenario, run, rfd, ofd, manifest, protocol, DEADLINE)
    except BaseException as exc:
        report["method_exception"] = err(exc)
        status = 3 if report["protocol"] is not None else 6
        event("original_child_method_exception", error=err(exc), selected_status_not_actual_exit=status)
    finally:
        if ofd is not None:
            os.close(ofd)
        if rfd is not None:
            os.close(rfd)
    report["owner"]["mono_end"] = time.monotonic()
    report["selected_status_not_actual_exit"] = status
    report["observed_maxrss_bytes"] = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss

    REPORTING = True  # Only bounded close/evidence work remains after a handled TERM.

def check():
    if time.monotonic() >= DEADLINE:
        raise OSError("ORACLE_COOPERATIVE_DEADLINE")


def need(condition, name):
    if not condition:
        FAILURES.append(name)


def exact(condition, name):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(name)


def integer(value):
    return type(value) is int


def number(value):
    return not isinstance(value, bool) and isinstance(value, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(value)


def typed_equal(a, b):
    if type(a) is not type(b):
        return False
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        return set(a) == set(b) and all(typed_equal(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a, list):
        return len(a) == len(b) and all(typed_equal(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    return a == b


def created_continuity(wanted, facts):
    exact(isinstance(wanted, dict) and set(wanted) == {"path", "inode", "sha256", "bytes", "nlink", "creation_ordinal"} and
          integer(wanted["creation_ordinal"]) and wanted["creation_ordinal"] >= 0 and
          integer(wanted["nlink"]) and wanted["nlink"] == 1 and
          all(typed_equal(wanted[k], facts[k]) for k in ("path", "inode", "sha256", "bytes", "nlink")),
          "original approved exclusive creation inode/content continuity")


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def pairs(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError("duplicate JSON key")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def decode(raw):
    def finite(text):
        result = float(text)
        if not math.isfinite(result):
            raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON")
        return result
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_float=finite,
                      parse_constant=lambda x: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("nonfinite JSON")))


def packed(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()


def directory(path):
    exact(isinstance(path, str) and path.startswith("/") and os.path.normpath(path) == path, "canonical directory")
    fd = os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        for part in path.split("/")[1:]:
            check()
            child = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
            os.close(fd)
            fd = child
        return fd
    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)
        raise


def inode(fd):
    value = os.fstat(fd)
    return [value.st_dev, value.st_ino]


def regular(path, cap=16 << 20):
    parent = directory(os.path.dirname(path))
    fd = None
    try:
        fd = os.open(os.path.basename(path), os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        exact(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and 0 <= before.st_size <= cap, "bounded regular")
        result = bytearray()
        while len(result) < before.st_size:
            check()
            raw = os.read(fd, min(65536, before.st_size - len(result)))
            exact(bool(raw), "short regular read")
            result.extend(raw)
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        exact(not os.read(fd, 1) and (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ctime_ns) ==
              (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns), "regular changed")
        named = os.stat(os.path.basename(path), dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        exact((named.st_dev, named.st_ino, named.st_size, named.st_mtime_ns, named.st_ctime_ns) ==
              (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns), "original regular pathname replaced during read")
        return {"path": path, "inode": [before.st_dev, before.st_ino], "sha256": sha(result),
                "bytes": len(result), "nlink": before.st_nlink}, bytes(result)
    finally:
        if fd is not None:
            os.close(fd)
        os.close(parent)


def error_text(value):
    exact(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"type", "errno", "UTF8_HEX", "utf8_bytes", "text_scope"}, "error raw schema")
    exact(value["text_scope"] == "MODEL_INPUT_NOT_ACTUAL_BIN_DATE", "error date scope")
    raw = bytes.fromhex(value["UTF8_HEX"])
    exact(integer(value["utf8_bytes"]) and value["utf8_bytes"] == len(raw), "complete, not truncated, error text evidence")
    return raw.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")


def pick(events, operation):
    return [v for v in events if v["operation"] == operation]


def only(events, operation):
    values = pick(events, operation)
    exact(len(values) == 1, "exact one raw event: " + operation)
    return values[0]


def resources(value):
    return isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"charged_bytes", "lane_bytes", "free"} and all(integer(v) and v >= 0 for v in value.values())
